products.description:
ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-E GAMING WIFI ATX Motherboard

ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-E GAMING WIFI 14th Gen  Motherboard features LGA 1700 socket and Z790 chipset which supports Intel Socket LGA1700 for 13th Gen Intel Core & 12th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron Processors. This motherboard comes with 4 x DIMM that supports DDR5 Dual-Channel RAM up to 128GB of memory with speeds up to 7200 MHz when overclocked. This provides you with increased multitasking and rendering capabilities. It comes with 5x M.2 PCIe and four SATA III storage interfaces allow you to combine an array of storage drives to build a massive gaming library. It also has a single PCIe 5.0 x16 slot that supports resource-intensive graphics cards, while two PCIe 4.0 x16 (in x4 mode) and one PCIe 3.0 x1 slots support a variety of utility cards. Several USB 2.0, 3.2 Gen 1, Gen 2, and Gen 2x2 interfaces are accessible via the back panel and internal headers, providing ample support for peripherals such as mice, keyboards, and controllers as well as resource-demanding devices such as external drives. Bluetooth 5.2 technology can be used by wireless devices to provide a reliable cable-free experience. Use Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) to connect to your wireless network, or the integrated 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port if you prefer a wired connection.

AI Overclocking

The ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-E GAMING WIFI can boost performance with automatic AI overclocking and cooling, enhancing your games and productivity without sacrificing thermal capabilities. AI noise cancellation is an audio-focused utility that reduces background noise, allowing others to hear you more clearly when playing team-based games or delivering presentations remotely. GameFirst VI is an artificial intelligence networking tool that prioritizes and optimizes your network connection for smoother online gameplay, which is essential for competitive online titles.

Enhanced Power Solution

ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-E GAMING WIFI delivers stable power throughout the entire motherboard, maintaining electrical volume whether performing simple tasks or operating at full power during resource-demanding processes, thanks to 16+1 70A power stages with ProCool II connectors, alloy chokes, and durable capacitors.

Comprehensive Cooling

The 14th Gen Motherboard incorporates a large VRM heatsink for capacitors and chokes, as well as integrated double-sided M.2 heatsinks and a unique PCH fanless heatsink, to ensure your system remains cool under heavy loads, delivering better thermal performance while preventing throttling. Fan Xpert 4 software and hybrid fan headers control fans and liquid pump elements for enhanced cooling that can be customized.

ROG SupremeFX 7.1 Surround Sound High Definition Audio

Immerse yourself in your favorite games with the help of high-fidelity audio powered by the Savitech SV3H712 amplifier and ROG SupremeFX 7.1-channel ALC4080 codec. Premium capacitors and audio jacks with gold plating enhance audio conductivity for a dependable signal and reduce static and other interference.

Leading Connectivity

The ASUS ROG STRIX Z790-E GAMING WIFI ATX Motherboard provides reliable connectivity for your peripherals between the internal headers and the backplate. Webcams, microphones, and external storage drives can transfer data at speeds of up to 5 and 10 Gb/s through USB-A and USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 and Gen 2 ports, respectively. For devices that require a lot of resources, like storage arrays and audio interfaces, a USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 port offers up to 20 Gb/s data transfer speed. In addition to facilitating data transfer, a front panel USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 port provides up to 30W Power Delivery to charge and support peripherals that require a lot of resources. With an internal Thunderbolt 4 header, you can increase your connectivity and take advantage of high-speed connectivity that supports quick transfer rates and Power Delivery technologies.

Premium capacitors and audio jacks with gold plating enhance audio conductivity for a dependable signal and reduce static and other interference.

Leading Connectivity

This 14th Gen Motherboard provides reliable connectivity for your peripherals between the internal headers and the backplate. Webcams, microphones, and external storage drives can transfer data at speeds of up to 5 and 10 Gb/s through USB-A and USB-C 3.2 Gen 1 and Gen 2 ports, respectively. For devices that require a lot of resources, like storage arrays and audio interfaces, a USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 port offers up to 20 Gb/s data transfer speed. ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI LGA1851 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI is a high-end ATX motherboard designed for Intel Core Ultra Processors (Series 2), featuring the LGA1851 socket and Intel Z890 chipset. It supports Intel Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and 3.0, as well as high-speed DDR5 memory support for up to 256GB across four DIMM slots at rates of 9200+MT/s (OC). The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI Motherboard includes a dual-channel memory architecture, Intel XMP, DIMM Flex, NitroPath DRAM Technology, and ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile III (AEMP III). One DisplayPort, one HDMI port, and two Thunderbolt 4 ports provide 8K@60Hz output, with extra USB Type-C DP alt mode capability. One PCIe 5.0 x16 slot and one PCIe 4.0 x16 slot are dedicated to expansion. The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI LGA1851 Motherboard has seven M.2 slots and four SATA 6Gb/s connections for storage, with M.2_1, M.2_3, and M.2_4 supporting PCIe 5.0 x4 as well as PCIe and SATA RAID. The network configuration comprises Realtek 5Gb Ethernet with LANGuard and 2x2 Wi-Fi 7 with Bluetooth v5.4. The rear USB ports feature two Thunderbolt 4 Type-C, nine USB 10Gbps, and three USB 5Gbps. The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI LGA1851 ATX Motherboard features a front panel with one USB 20Gbps Type-C, four USB 5Gbps, and six USB 2.0 connections. The ROG SupremeFX ALC4080 codec provides 7.1 surround sound, gold-plated jacks, a Savitech amplifier, S/PDIF output, and premium capacitors. The internal connectors include fan headers, an AIO pump, a temperature sensor, and several RGB headers. ASUS Q-Design with M.2 Q-Latch and PCIe Slot Q-Release, robust thermal solutions for M.2 and VRM, and software such as Armoury Crate, Aura Creator, Fan Xpert 4, and AI Overclocking are among the standout features. The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-E GAMING WIFI LGA1851 ATX Motherboard runs Windows 11 (22H2 and later), has a 256Mb UEFI BIOS, and includes proprietary tools such as BIOS FlashBack, USB Wattage Watcher, and Dolby Atmos support, making it an excellent choice for performance-driven PC setups.

ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-H GAMING WIFI LGA1851 ATX Motherboard

The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-H GAMING WIFI ATX Motherboard is a high-performance gaming and enthusiast board designed to support the latest Intel Core Ultra Processors (Series 2) using the LGA1851 socket, powered by the advanced Intel Z890 chipset. The ASUS ROG STRIX Z890-H GAMING WIFI Motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 RAM across 4 DIMM slots, with overclocking speeds reaching 9066+ MT/s, enhanced by cutting-edge technologies like DIMM Flex, NitroPath DRAM, AEMP III, and Intel XMP. The rear I/O includes 10 USB ports (including dual USB Type-C 20Gbps with 30W PD fast charging), while the front panel offers 7 more USB connections. products.name: ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II LGA1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard
products.description:
ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II LGA1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard

The ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II is a powerful micro-ATX motherboard based on the Intel B760 chipset. It supports Intel Core 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation processors, including Pentium Gold and Celeron, using the LGA1700 socket. It supports Intel Turbo Boost Technology 2.0 and 3.0, which provides high-performance computing. This ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II Motherboard has four DDR5 DIMM slots that can accommodate up to 192GB of memory at speeds up to 7800+MT/s (OC) in dual-channel architecture. It supports Intel XMP and ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile II (AEMP II) for better tweaking. The graphics output features one DisplayPort 1.4 and one HDMI 2.1 connector, both of which enable 4K at 60Hz. Expansion slots include a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot from the CPU, one PCIe 4.0 x4, and one PCIe 3.0 x1. The ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II LGA1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard has three M.2 slots and four SATA 6Gb/s connections for storage. It also supports RAID 0/1/5/10 with Intel Rapid Storage Technology. The network is powered by a Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet with TUF LANGuard for increased stability and protection. A USB 20Gbps Type-C port, one USB 10Gbps Type-A, two USB 5Gbps Type-A, and four USB 2.0 connectors make up the rear I/O. The ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II LGA1700 Motherboard front panel can accommodate up to eight USB ports, including USB Type-C and USB 5Gbps/2.0 headers. Realtek 7.1 surround sound, premium capacitors, audio shielding, optical S/PDIF out, and 24-bit/192kHz playback are all included in the audio specifications. The CPU, chassis, and AIO pump are all cooled via headers, as are the VRM and M.2 heatsinks. ASUS Q-Design features including M.2 Q-Latch, PCIe Q-Release, Q-DIMM, and Q-LED make assembly easier. The ASUS TUF GAMING B760M-PLUS II LGA1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard also has Aura Sync with Gen 2 RGB headers, a pre-mounted I/O shield, ProCool connections, SafeSlot Core+, AI Noise Cancelation, and software like as Armoury Crate and Fan Xpert 2+. It supports Windows 11 and 10, making it suitable for long-lasting, efficient, and performance-driven PC setups.

products.description:
Asus ROG STRIX B850-G GAMING WIFI mATX Motherboard

The ASUS TUF GAMING B850-BTF WIFI W ATX Motherboard is a robust and innovative Asus TUF Gaming Motherboard designed for builders who demand high-end performance and advanced cable management in full-size builds. As part of the forward-looking Asus BTF Motherboard lineup, it features the AMD B850 chipset and supports Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors via the AM5 socket, ensuring exceptional power and compatibility for gaming and creative workloads. This Asus 850 Motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 memory with speeds reaching beyond 8000 MT/s (OC), enhanced with AMD EXPO and ASUS AEMP profiles for seamless memory tuning. Unique to the BTF design, all connectors are cleverly placed at the rear, enabling ultra-clean cable routing and a sleek finish when paired with compatible cases and GPUs featuring hidden power delivery—up to 600W directly via the board. As a top-tier Asus B850 BTF Motherboard, it incorporates a 14+2+1 power stage design with 80A stages, ProCool connectors, premium alloy chokes, and massive VRM heatsinks to ensure stable voltage under heavy loads. Storage and expansion are future-ready with three M.2 slots (including one PCIe 5.0 x4), four SATA 6Gb/s ports, and PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 expansion slots, while this high-performance Asus WiFi Motherboard includes cutting-edge WiFi 7, Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet, and HDMI/DisplayPort outputs for versatile connectivity. USB support is extensive with USB 20Gbps Type-C, USB 10Gbps front panel ports, and a rich selection of rear I/O for comprehensive peripheral support. Audio is delivered through the Realtek ALC1220P codec with DTS and premium signal isolation, providing crystal-clear sound for immersive gaming and media. DIY enhancements like PCIe Slot Q-Release Slim, M.2 Q-Latch, Q-Antenna, BIOS FlashBack, and Q-LEDs simplify installation and maintenance, while three Gen 2 ARGB headers and Aura Sync lighting enable bold customization. Altogether, the ASUS TUF GAMING B850-BTF WIFI W ATX Motherboard blends performance, innovation, and visual refinement, making it a standout choice among modern Asus Motherboards for gamers and creators building clean and powerful desktop systems.

products.description:
Asus TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard

The Asus TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard is a high-performance platform engineered for gamers and professionals, offering full compatibility with AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors via the advanced AM5 socket and powered by the latest chipset technology. The Asus TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI ATX Motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 RAM across 4 DIMM slots, with speeds reaching 8000+ MT/s (OC) and enhanced compatibility through AMD EXPO and ASUS AEMP profiles. It delivers immersive visuals via one HDMI 2.1 port and dual USB4 Type-C ports with DisplayPort 1.4a support, enabling 4K@60Hz resolution, depending on CPU specifications. Designed for extreme expandability, the Asus TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI Motherboard features one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot, multiple PCIe 4.0 and 3.0 slots, and three M.2 sockets supporting PCIe Gen 5 and Gen 4 SSDs. It also includes four SATA 6Gb/s ports and comprehensive RAID support via AMD RAIDXpert2 Technology, tailored by CPU generation. Connectivity on the Asus TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI is cutting-edge, with 2 x USB4 (40Gbps) Type-C ports, 10 rear USB ports, 7 front USB headers, and fast Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet. For wireless communication, it supports Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) on 2.4/5GHz bands and Bluetooth 5.2. Audio is enhanced by a Realtek 7.1 High Definition Surround Sound Codec, supporting jack detection, multi-streaming, and 24-bit/192kHz playback, along with audio shielding, premium capacitors, and dedicated PCB layers. Internally, the board features an array of headers including ARGB Gen 2, fan headers, TPM, COM, S/PDIF, and USB 2.0/3.2 headers. ASUS-exclusive technologies such as Q-Design (M.2 Q-Latch, PCIe Q-Release, Q-LED) and EZ DIY features (CrashFree BIOS 3, EZ Flash 3, BIOS FlashBack™, pre-mounted I/O shield) make setup and troubleshooting seamless. The Asus TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard is fortified with ASUS 5X Protection III, offering DIGI+ VRM, SafeSlot, LANGuard, and stainless steel back I/O for enhanced durability. With Aura Sync RGB lighting, bundled software like Armoury Crate, Aura Creator, ASUS GlideX, ASUS DriverHub, and trials for Norton 360 Deluxe and WinRAR, the Asus TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI ATX Motherboard is a complete solution for building a future-ready, high-performance PC.

Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W AM5 ATX Motherboard

The Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W AM5 ATX Motherboard is a powerhouse platform engineered for high-end gaming and content creation. Built on the latest AMD X870 chipset, it supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors via the AM5 socket, delivering top-tier performance and future-ready features. This Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W Motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 RAM across four DIMM slots, with overclocking capabilities reaching 8000+ MT/s, along with ECC/Non-ECC support, dual-channel architecture, AMD EXPO, and ASUS AEMP profiles for enhanced memory tuning. For graphics, the Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W AM5 ATX Motherboard provides an HDMI 2.1 port and two USB4 Type-C ports supporting up to 4K@60Hz output, depending on CPU specifications. Expansion options include a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for Ryzen 9000/7000 CPUs, additional PCIe 4.0 and 3.0 slots, and three M.2 slots (PCIe 5.0 & 4.0), along with four SATA 6Gb/s ports. RAID configurations are supported via AMD RAIDXpert2, including RAID 0/1/5/10 for Ryzen 9000 processors. This Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W motherboard offers comprehensive connectivity, including 2 x USB4 (40Gbps), 10 rear USB ports, 7 front USB ports (with a USB 20Gbps Type-C supporting 30W PD fast-charging), and Realtek 2.5Gb Ethernet. Wireless features include Wi-Fi 6 with 2.4/5GHz support and Bluetooth 5.2. Audiophiles will appreciate the premium Realtek 7.1 Surround Sound High Definition Audio CODEC, which supports 24-bit/192kHz playback, audio shielding, and premium capacitors. Internally, the Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W AM5 ATX Motherboard features multiple fan headers, addressable RGB Gen 2 headers, SPI TPM, S/PDIF out, and front audio connectors. ASUS-exclusive features like Q-Design (M.2 Q-Latch, PCIe Q-Release, Q-LEDs), 5X Protection III (DIGI+ VRM, SafeSlot, LANGuard), and pre-mounted I/O shield enhance durability and ease of installation. The motherboard supports advanced cooling via VRM and M.2 heatsinks, while Fan Xpert 4 offers AI-powered thermal control. With Aura Sync RGB, BIOS Flashback, and bundled software like Armoury Crate, Aura Creator, ASUS DriverHub, and more, the Asus X870 AYW GAMING WIFI W Motherboard is the ultimate choice for gamers and PC enthusiasts seeking performance, reliability, and customization.

CONNECTIVITY

The onboard 802.11ac WIFI module from Intel supports Dual Band and up to 433 Mbps, 3x faster WIFI speed than 802.11n and also support BLUETOOTH 4.2. GIGABYTE Motherboards are focused on delivering M.2 technology to enthusiasts who want to maximize their systemâ€™s potential. Realtek 8118 LAN is a high performance and friendly network chip for gaming players with automatic bandwidth allocation to ensure the highest network priority of the game or application. It can provide users the most comprehensive features and the fastest and smoothest Internet experience. HDMI 2.1, which is backwards compatible with HDMI 2.0/ 1.4 and offering 48 Gb/s of bandwidth â€“ twice times more than previous generation. This unlocks the potential for users to transfer multiple video streams, as well as a native cinematic 21:9 ratio (which most movies are shot in), Full HDR and HDCP 2.3 support, to offer the best visual experience for viewers.

COOLING

With Smart Fan 5 users can ensure that their gaming PC can maintain its performance while staying cool. Smart Fan 5 allows users to interchange their fan headers to reflect different thermal sensors at different locations on the motherboard. Not only that, with Smart Fan 5 more hybrid fan headers that support both PWM and Voltage mode fans have been introduced to make the motherboard more liquid cooling friendly. Achieve fan silence. With Fan Stop, map any fan to stop completely when temperatures drop below a specified threshold. Which fan stops, based on readings from which sensor, and at what temperatureâ€”all of it can be customized to your liking.

LIGHTING

With A520 Motherboards, RGB Fusion 2.0 is even better with Addressable LEDs. RGB Fusion 2.0 offers users the option to control onboard RGB and external RGB / Addressable LED light strips* for their PC build. Already feature filled with colors and patterns, RGB Fusion 2.0 are now upgraded to improve the Addressable LED support. With external Addressable LED strips, where each LED is digitally addressable that users can experience even more patterns, styles, and illuminations. With A520 Motherboards support the external 5V Addressable LED lighting strips and up to 300 LED lights. RGB Fusion 2.0 with Addressable LEDs comes with new patterns and various speed settings with more to come. With an integrated intuitive user interface, the RGB Fusion 2.0 provides you a better solution for customizing the lighting effects across all supported devices. From motherboards, graphics cards to the peripheral products, you can personalize your gaming rig with your own style and show off your build by sharing the profiles. In addition, the new gaming mode makes the lighting effects interactive with selected games to bring you the most immersive gaming experience.

AUDIO

GIGABYTE motherboards use high-end audio capacitors. These high quality capacitors help deliver high resolution and high fidelity audio to provide the most realistic sound effects for gamers. GIGABYTE motherboards feature an audio noise guard that essentially separates the boardâ€™s sensitive analog audio components from potential noise pollution at the PCB level.

ULTRA DURABLE

With GIGABYTE Q-Flash Plus, you donâ€™t need to install the CPU, memory and graphics card nor enter the BIOS menu to flash the BIOS. Just download and save a new BIOS file (rename to gigabyte.bin) on the USB flash drive, then press the dedicated Q-Flash Plus button and youâ€™re good to go! A520 motherboards feature solid plated ATX 12V 8pin power connectors for offering stable power supply while CPU overloading. Sulfur compounds in the air can penetrate tiny onboard resistors creating chemical change and causing these resistors to open or short. If either of these occurs the motherboard will fail to function. By equipping resistors with an Anti-Sulfur Design GIGABYTE gives Ultra Durable Motherboards a whole new meaning.

GIGABYTE A520M H AM4 Micro ATX Motherboard

GIGABYTE UD series motherboards use a 4+3 phases pure digital PWM + Low RDS(on) MOSFETs design to support the 3rd Gen AMD Ryzenâ„¢ CPUs by offering incredible precision in delivering power to the motherboard's most power-hungry and energy-sensitive components as well as delivering enhanced system performance and ultimate hardware scalability. GIGABYTE Motherboards are focused on delivering M.2 technology to enthusiasts who want to maximize their systemâ€™s potential.

PERFORMANCE

Realtek 8118 LAN is a high performance and friendly network chip for gaming players with automatic bandwidth allocation to ensure the highest network priority of the game or application. It can provide users the most comprehensive features and the fastest and smoothest Internet experience. HDMI 2.1, which is backwards compatible with HDMI 2.0/ 1.4 and offering 48 Gb/s of bandwidth â€“ twice times more than previous generation. This unlocks the potential for users to transfer multiple video streams, as well as a native cinematic 21:9 ratio (which most movies are shot in), Full HDR and HDCP 2.3 support, to offer the best visual experience for viewers. GIGABYTE motherboards use ICs with up to 3 times the ESD resistance levels compared to traditional ICs. This helps to better protect the motherboard and its components against potential damage caused by static electricity. GIGABYTE motherboards also feature special anti-surge ICs that protect your motherboard, and your PC from any surge in power delivery that may occur, helping to ensure that your PC is equipped to deal with any potentially irregular and inconsistent power delivery.

High-End Audio Capacitors

GIGABYTE motherboards use high-end audio capacitors. These high quality capacitors help deliver high resolution and high fidelity audio to provide the most realistic sound effects for gamers. GIGABYTE motherboards feature an audio noise guard that essentially separates the boardâ€™s sensitive analog audio components from potential noise pollution at the PCB level.

COOLING

With Smart Fan 5 users can ensure that their gaming PC can maintain its performance while staying cool. Smart Fan 5 allows users to interchange their fan headers to reflect different thermal sensors at different locations on the motherboard. Not only that, with Smart Fan 5 more hybrid fan headers that support both PWM and Voltage mode fans have been introduced to make the motherboard more liquid cooling friendly. Achieve fan silence. With Fan Stop, map any fan to stop completely when temperatures drop below a specified threshold. Which fan stops, based on readings from which sensor, and at what temperatureâ€”all of it can be customized to your liking.

LIGHTING

With A520 Motherboards, RGB Fusion 2.0 is even better with Addressable LEDs. RGB Fusion 2.0 offers users the option to control onboard RGB and external RGB / Addressable LED light strips* for their PC build. Already feature filled with colors and patterns, RGB Fusion 2.0 are now upgraded to improve the Addressable LED support. With external Addressable LED strips, where each LED is digitally addressable that users can experience even more patterns, styles, and illuminations. With A520 Motherboards support the external 5V Addressable LED lighting strips and up to 300 LED lights. RGB Fusion 2.0 with Addressable LEDs comes with new patterns and various speed settings with more to come. With an integrated intuitive user interface, the RGB Fusion 2.0 provides you a better solution for customizing the lighting effects across all supported devices. From motherboards, graphics cards to the peripheral products, you can personalize your gaming rig with your own style and show off your build by sharing the profiles. In addition, the new gaming mode makes the lighting effects interactive with selected games to bring you the most immersive gaming experience.

ULTRA DURABLE

With GIGABYTE Q-Flash Plus, you donâ€™t need to install the CPU, memory and graphics card nor enter the BIOS menu to flash the BIOS. Just download and save a new BIOS file (rename to gigabyte.bin) on the USB flash drive, then press the dedicated Q-Flash Plus button and youâ€™re good to go! A520 motherboards feature solid plated ATX 12V 8pin power connectors for offering stable power supply while CPU overloading. Sulfur compounds in the air can penetrate tiny onboard resistors creating chemical change and causing these resistors to open or short. If either of these occurs the motherboard will fail to function. By equipping resistors with an Anti-Sulfur Design GIGABYTE gives Ultra Durable Motherboards a whole new meaning.

GIGABYTE Motherboards are focused on delivering M.2 technology to enthusiasts who want to maximize their system's potential. The BIOS is essential for users during the initial setup to allow for the most optimal settings. products.name: GIGABYTE A620M H AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard
products.description:
GIGABYTE A620M H AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE A620M H is a versatile Micro-ATX motherboard designed for AMD Socket AM5, making it compatible with the latest AMD Ryzen 7000, 8000, and 9000 series processors. It offers unparalleled performance with a 5+2+2 phase digital VRM solution, ensuring stable power delivery and enhanced overclocking capabilities. The motherboard supports dual-channel DDR5 memory, accommodating up to two SMD DIMMs and providing support for AMD EXPO and Intel XMP memory modules for optimized performance. For storage, it includes a PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 connector, enabling rapid data access and quick boot times with the latest NVMe SSDs. The GIGABYTE A620M H also features an EZ-Latch PCIe x16 slot, making it easy to install and remove graphics cards without tools. It offers reliable network connectivity through a Gigabit Ethernet (GbE) LAN port and extended display options with both DisplayPort and HDMI outputs, supporting multiple monitor setups. The Smart Fan 6 technology includes advanced fan controls with multiple temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers, supporting both PWM and DC fans. The FAN STOP feature further enhances energy efficiency and reduces noise by stopping the fans when the system is cool enough. The Q-Flash Plus feature allows for BIOS updates without the need for a CPU, memory, or graphics card, simplifying maintenance and upgrades. Overall, this motherboard provides a robust platform for building a modern PC, offering a blend of advanced features and future-proofing capabilities.

products.description:
Gigabyte B450M DS3H V2 AMD AM4 Micro ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B450M DS3H V2 Micro-ATX Motherboard Supports AMD Ryzen 5000 series / Ryzen 5000 G-Series/ 3rd Gen Ryzen/ 2nd Gen Ryzen/ 1st Gen Ryzen/ 2nd Gen Ryzen with Radeon Vega Graphics/ 1st Gen Ryzen with Radeon Vega Graphics/ Athlon with Radeon Vega Graphics Processors. The DS3H is constructed using AMD's B450 chipset, providing you access to an AM4 CPU socket that works with specific Ryzen processors. You can install different memory modules for faster multitasking with the help of four dual-channel DIMMs. Utilize the four SATA III ports and one M.2 PCIe connector to benefit from increased storage capacity. Install many graphics and utility cards using a single PCIe x16 slot. Utility cards can also be installed in PCIe x4 and x1 slots.

Ultimate Power Design

The Gigabyte B450M DS3H V2 Micro ATX Motherboard's glass fabric printed circuit board and 4+2 phase digital VRM solution design balance voltage, prevent moisture and stabilize system performance. This board can easily handle a range of current levels due to the improvement in transient response provided by digital PWM and Low RDS(on) MOSFET components. Connectors with solid pins encourage toughness and conductivity for reliable electrical connections. Resistors are given an extra layer of safety by having an anti-sulfur design, which stops impurities from damaging your motherboard and causing component failure. Furthermore, this motherboard complies with CEC 2019 criteria and is approved by the California Energy Commission.

Networking Connectivity

Gigabyte B450M DS3H V2 comes with an 8118 Gaming LAN adapter, which is necessary for competitive online gaming and live broadcasting, enables faster network rates. The multi-gig configurations are also backward compatible with this.

Hi-Fi Audio

The Gigabyte B450M DS3H V2 is designed for gaming and media aficionados, with high-quality audio components and Audio Noise Guard with LED trace route lighting to deliver a deep and immersive audio experience.

Smart Fan 5

Smart Fan 5, a free suite focused on ensuring your components work properly, may be used to monitor your build's cooling performance. Five temperature sensors, as well as three hybrid fan headers, are distributed throughout the board to provide optimal control and cooling. When the appropriate temperature is reached, the fans shut down automatically, extending fan life.

products.name: Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 AMD AM4 Micro ATX Motherboard
products.description:
Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 AMD AM4 Micro ATX Motherboard

The Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 is a compact yet powerful Micro ATX motherboard engineered for AMD AM4 socket processors, making it a versatile foundation for gaming rigs, productivity setups, and budget-friendly builds. With robust support for a wide range of AMD Ryzen CPUs including the latest Ryzen 5000 Series, 5000G, 4000G, and earlier generations with Radeon Vega Graphics and Athlon processors this Gigabyte motherboard ensures future-ready compatibility and performance scalability. Powered by the reliable AMD B450 chipset, it features four DDR4 DIMM slots supporting up to 128GB of system memory, dual-channel architecture, and XMP profiles for enhanced memory tuning. Whether you're running DDR4 2933 or stepping down to 2133 MT/s, the Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 motherboard handles both ECC and non-ECC unbuffered modules with ease, offering flexibility for creators and multitaskers alike. Graphics output is handled via an integrated HDMI 2.1 port with support for 4K resolution at 60Hz and HDCP 2.2, making it ideal for media streaming, casual gaming, or multi-monitor productivity. Audio is powered by Realtek HD codec, delivering immersive 7.1-channel sound with S/PDIF Out support and customizable jack functionality through bundled software. Networking is seamless thanks to the Realtek Gigabit LAN chip, ensuring stable and fast internet connectivity for online gaming, streaming, or remote work. Expansion options include one PCIe 3.0 x16 slot for high-performance GPUs, a secondary PCIe x16 slot running at x1, and a PCIe x1 slot for additional cards. Storage is future-proofed with a high-speed M.2 connector supporting both SATA and PCIe NVMe SSDs (up to 22110 form factor), alongside four SATA 6Gb/s ports with RAID 0, 1, and 10 support for data redundancy and speed. USB connectivity is generous, with four USB 3.1 Gen 1 ports on the rear I/O, two more via internal headers, and six USB 2.0 ports for legacy peripherals. The Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 AMD AM4 also includes RGB Fusion support with multiple LED headers standard and addressable allowing builders to customize lighting effects and sync with other RGB components. Smart Fan control, temperature and voltage monitoring, and fail warnings ensure thermal stability and system longevity. BIOS features include a 128Mbit AMI UEFI BIOS with support for Q-Flash and Xpress Install, making updates and setup intuitive even for first-time builders. Bundled with Norton Internet Security and LAN bandwidth management software, the B450M DS3H V3 is optimized for secure, high-speed performance. It supports Windows 11, 10, and even Windows 7 (with Pinnacle Ridge or Summit Ridge CPUs), making it a flexible choice for users with legacy systems or modern OS needs. Measuring 24.4cm x 21.5cm, this Gigabyte B450M DS3H V3 Micro ATX motherboard fits comfortably in most mid-tower and compact cases, offering a perfect blend of affordability, reliability, and feature-rich design for DIY PC enthusiasts, gamers, and professionals alike.

GIGABYTE 400-series motherboards maximize your PC's potential with AMD StoreMI technology. StoreMI accelerates traditional storage devices to reduce boot times and enhance the overall user experience. This easy-to-use utility combines the speed of SSDs with the high capacity of HDDs into a single drive, enhances the read/write speeds of the device to match that of SSDs, bolsters data performance for incredible value, and transforms the everyday PC to a performance-driven system. GIGABYTE B550M DS3H AC Micro ATX AMD Motherboard

GIGABYTE UD series motherboards use a 5+3 phases pure digital PWM + Low RDS(on) MOSFETs design to support the 3rd Gen AMD Ryzen CPUs by offering incredible precision in delivering power to the motherboard's most power-hungry and energy-sensitive components as well as delivering enhanced system performance and ultimate hardware scalability. With NVMe PCIe 4.0*/3.0 x4 and PCIe 3.0 x2 M.2 connectors onboard, GIGABYTE Motherboards bring users to experience NVMe mode or SATA mode connectivity for M.2 SSD devices. Delivering up to 64 Gb/s data transfer speed, the dual M.2 connectors design provides an ideal storage solution while also supporting in RAID modes. Realtek 8118 LAN is a high performance and friendly network chip for gaming players with automatic bandwidth allocation to ensure the highest network priority of the game or application. It can provide users the most comprehensive features and the fastest and smoothest Internet experience. HDMI 2.1, which is backward compatible with HDMI 2.0/ 1.4 and offering 48 Gb/s of bandwidth â€“ twice times more than the previous generation. This unlocks the potential for users to transfer multiple video streams, as well as a native cinematic 21:9 ratio (which most movies are shot in), Full HDR, and HDCP 2.3 support, to offer the best visual experience for viewers. With Smart Fan, 5 users can ensure that their gaming PC can maintain its performance while staying cool. Smart Fan 5 allows users to interchange their fan headers to reflect different thermal sensors at different locations on the motherboard. Not only that, with Smart Fan, but 5 more hybrid fan headers that support both PWM and Voltage mode fans have also been introduced to make the motherboard more liquid cooling friendly. Achieve fan silence. With Fan Stop, map any fan to stop completely when temperatures drop below a specified threshold. Which fan stops, based on readings from which sensor, and at what temperatureâ€”all of it can be customized to your liking. With B550 Motherboards, RGB Fusion 2.0 is even better with Addressable LEDs. RGB Fusion 2.0 offers users the option to control onboard RGB and external RGB / Addressable LED light strips* for their PC build. Already feature filled with colors and patterns, RGB Fusion 2.0 is now upgraded to improve the Addressable LED support. With external Addressable LED strips, where each LED is digitally addressable that users can experience even more patterns, styles, and illuminations. With B550 Motherboards support the external 5V Addressable LED lighting strips and up to 300 LED lights. RGB Fusion 2.0 with Addressable LEDs comes with new patterns and various speed settings with more to come. With an integrated intuitive user interface, the RGB Fusion 2.0 provides you a better solution for customizing the lighting effects across all supported devices. From motherboards, graphics cards to the peripheral products, you can personalize your gaming rig with your own style and show off your build by sharing the profiles. In addition, the new gaming mode makes the lighting effects interactive with selected games to bring you the most immersive gaming experience. GIGABYTE motherboards use high-end audio capacitors. These high-quality capacitors help deliver high resolution and high fidelity audio to provide the most realistic sound effects for gamers. GIGABYTE motherboards feature an audio noise guard that essentially separates the boardâ€™s sensitive analog audio components from potential noise pollution at the PCB level. With GIGABYTE Q-Flash Plus, you donâ€™t need to install the CPU, memory, and graphics card nor enter the BIOS menu to flash the BIOS. Just download and save a new BIOS file (rename to gigabyte.bin) on the USB flash drive, then press the dedicated Q-Flash Plus button and youâ€™re good to go! Sulfur compounds in the air can penetrate tiny onboard resistors creating chemical change and causing these resistors to open or short. If either of these occurs the motherboard will fail to function. By equipping resistors with an Anti-Sulfur Design GIGABYTE gives Ultra Durable Motherboards a whole new meaning. The BIOS is essential for users during the initial setup to allow for the most optimal settings. With a new GUI and easier to use functionalities, GIGABYTE has been able to reinvent the BIOS to give users a better experience while setting up their new system.

PCIe 4.0 Hardware Design

With NVMe PCIe 4.0*/3.0 x4 M.2 connector onboard, GIGABYTE Motherboards bring users to experience NVMe mode or SATA mode connectivity with delivering up to 64 Gb/s data transfer speed.

UNPARALLELED PERFORMANCE

GIGABYTE realize that customer won't stop chasing a better computing performance. We take care of it and implement on products. Protective and optimized memory trace enhance the performance. Faster read and write are needed to save time and improve efficiency. We offer plenty of M.2 storage with thermal guards to ensure unthrottled read and write. Exclusive Realtek 8118 Gaming LAN

Realtek 8118 LAN is a high performance and friendly network chip for gaming players with automatic bandwidth allocation to ensure the highest network priority of the game or application. It can provide users the most comprehensive features and the fastest and smoothest Internet experience. GIGABYTE motherboards use ICs with up to 3 times the ESD resistance levels compared to traditional ICs. This helps to better protect the motherboard and its components against potential damage caused by static electricity. GIGABYTE motherboards also feature special anti-surge ICs that protect your motherboard, and your PC from any surge in power delivery that may occur, helping to ensure that your PC is equipped to deal with any potentially irregular and inconsistent power delivery.

HDMI 2.1 for 4K / 60P / 21:9 / HDCP 2.3 Support

This unlocks the potential for users to transfer multiple video streams, as well as a native cinematic 21:9 ratio (which most movies are shot in), Full HDR and HDCP 2.3 support, to offer the best visual experience for viewers.

High-End Audio Capacitors

GIGABYTE motherboards use high-end audio capacitors. These high quality capacitors help deliver high resolution and high fidelity audio to provide the most realistic sound effects for gamers. GIGABYTE motherboards feature an audio noise guard that essentially separates the boardâ€™s sensitive analog audio components from potential noise pollution at the PCB level.

RGB FUSION 2.0

Now offering more LED customizations than ever, users can truly adapt their PC to represent their lifestyle. With full RGB support and a redesigned RGB Fusion 2.0 application, the user has complete control over the LEDs which surround the motherboard.

Gigabyte B550M K WIFI6E AMD AM4 mATX Motherboard

The Gigabyte B550M K WIFI6E Motherboard is built for gamers, creators, and professionals who demand stability, speed, and next-generation connectivity. Powered by the AMD B550 chipset, this Gigabyte Ryzen Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 5000, 4000 G-Series, and 3000 Series processors, delivering reliable performance in a compact micro ATX form factor.

Powerful CPU and Memory Support

Designed for AMD Socket AM4, the Gigabyte B550M Motherboard supports the latest Ryzen processors with advanced PCIe 4.0 compatibility. With four DDR4 DIMM slots, it supports up to 128GB memory with speeds reaching DDR4 4733(O.C.), ensuring extreme bandwidth for multitasking and gaming. Dual-channel architecture, ECC and non-ECC DIMM support, plus XMP compatibility make this Gigabyte Motherboard versatile for performance-driven builds.

Graphics and Expansion

Integrated graphics deliver stunning visuals with DisplayPort 1.4 (up to 5120×2880@60Hz) and HDMI 2.1 (up to 4096×2160@60Hz), both supporting HDR and HDCP 2.3. Expansion options include PCIe 4.0 x16 for Ryzen 5000/3000 processors and PCIe 3.0 x16 for Ryzen G-Series processors, plus a PCIe 3.0 x1 slot for add-in cards. This ensures compatibility with modern GPUs and peripherals.

Connectivity and Storage

The Gigabyte WiFi Motherboard offers extensive connectivity with 4 × USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports, 2 × USB 3.2 Gen 1 headers, and 6 × USB 2.0 ports. Networking is powered by Realtek GbE LAN and integrated Wi-Fi 6E for ultra-fast wireless connections. Storage options include dual M.2 slots (PCIe 4.0/3.0 support depending on CPU) and 4 × SATA 6Gb/s connectors with RAID 0, 1, and 10 support, ensuring flexible and high-speed storage solutions.

Audio and Special Features

Powered by Realtek HD Audio CODEC, the Gigabyte B550M K WIFI6E Motherboard delivers 2/4/5.1/7.1-channel high-definition audio. Special features include Gigabyte APP Center, @BIOS, EasyTune, Smart Backup, System Information Viewer, Q-Flash, and Xpress Install. Bundled software includes Norton Internet Security OEM and LAN bandwidth management tools, enhancing both security and performance.

Compact and Reliable Design

With a micro ATX form factor (24.4cm × 24.4cm), the Gigabyte B550M K WIFI6E AMD AM4 Motherboard fits seamlessly into compact builds while offering robust features. Internal I/O includes CPU and system fan headers, TPM support, and front panel connectors, making it a reliable foundation for modern gaming and productivity setups.

Gigabyte B550M S2H AM4 AMD Micro ATX Motherboard

GIGABYTE UD series motherboards use a 5+3 phases pure digital PWM + Low RDS(on) MOSFETs design to support the 3rd Gen AMD Ryzen CPUs by offering incredible precision in delivering power to the motherboard's most power-hungry and energy-sensitive components as well as delivering enhanced system performance and ultimate hardware scalability. With NVMe PCIe 4.0/3.0 x4 M.2 connector onboard, GIGABYTE Motherboards bring users to experience NVMe mode or SATA mode connectivity with delivering up to 64 Gb/s data transfer speed. Realtek 8118 LAN is a high performance and friendly network chip for gaming players with automatic bandwidth allocation to ensure the highest network priority of the game or application. It can provide users the most comprehensive features and the fastest and smoothest Internet experience. GIGABYTE motherboards use ICs with up to 3 times the ESD resistance levels compared to traditional ICs. This helps to better protect the motherboard and its components against potential damage caused by static electricity. GIGABYTE motherboards also feature special anti-surge ICs that protect your motherboard, and your PC from any surge in power delivery that may occur, helping to ensure that your PC is equipped to deal with any potentially irregular and inconsistent power delivery. HDMI 2.1, which is backward compatible with HDMI 2.0/ 1.4 and offering 48 Gb/s of bandwidth â€“ twice times more than the previous generation. This unlocks the potential for users to transfer multiple video streams, as well as a native cinematic 21:9 ratio (which most movies are shot in), Full HDR, and HDCP 2.3 support, to offer the best visual experience for viewers. GIGABYTE motherboards use high-end audio capacitors. These high-quality capacitors help deliver high resolution and high fidelity audio to provide the most realistic sound effects for gamers. GIGABYTE motherboards feature an audio noise guard that essentially separates the boardâ€™s sensitive analog audio components from potential noise pollution at the PCB level. With Smart Fan, 5 users can ensure that their gaming PC can maintain its performance while staying cool. Smart Fan 5 allows users to interchange their fan headers to reflect different thermal sensors at different locations on the motherboard. Not only that, with Smart Fan, but 5 more hybrid fan headers that support both PWM and Voltage mode fans have also been introduced to make the motherboard more liquid cooling friendly. Achieve fan silence. With Fan Stop, map any fan to stop completely when temperatures drop below a specified threshold. Which fan stops, based on readings from which sensor, and at what temperatureâ€”all of it can be customized to your liking. With B550 Motherboards, RGB Fusion 2.0 is even better with Addressable LEDs. RGB Fusion 2.0 offers users the option to control onboard RGB and external RGB / Addressable LED light strips* for their PC build. Already feature filled with colors and patterns, RGB Fusion 2.0 is now upgraded to improve the Addressable LED support. With external Addressable LED strips, where each LED is digitally addressable that users can experience even more patterns, styles, and illuminations. With B550 Motherboards support the external 5V Addressable LED lighting strips and up to 300 LED lights. RGB Fusion 2.0 with Addressable LEDs comes with new patterns and various speed settings with more to come. With an integrated intuitive user interface, the RGB Fusion 2.0 provides you a better solution for customizing the lighting effects across all supported devices. From motherboards, graphics cards to the peripheral products, you can personalize your gaming rig with your own style and show off your build by sharing the profiles. In addition, the new gaming mode makes the lighting effects interactive with selected games to bring you the most immersive gaming experience. With GIGABYTE Q-Flash Plus, you donâ€™t need to install the CPU, memory, and graphics card nor enter the BIOS menu to flash the BIOS. Just download and save a new BIOS file (rename to gigabyte.bin) on the USB flash drive, then press the dedicated Q-Flash Plus button and youâ€™re good to go! Sulfur compounds in the air can penetrate tiny onboard resistors creating chemical change and causing these resistors to open or short. If either of these occurs the motherboard will fail to function. By equipping resistors with an Anti-Sulfur Design GIGABYTE gives Ultra Durable Motherboards a whole new meaning. products.description:
GIGABYTE B650 AORUS ELITE AX ICE DDR5 AM5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650 AORUS ELITE AX ICE is a high-performance ATX motherboard designed to support the latest AMD Ryzen 7000 and 8000 series processors. Built for gaming enthusiasts and power users, this motherboard offers an array of advanced features to ensure superior performance, efficient thermal management, and robust connectivity options. It utilizes the AMD Socket AM5, making it compatible with future-proof AMD Ryzen processors. The motherboard's power delivery system features a Twin 12+2+2 Phases Digital VRM Solution, providing stable and efficient power to the CPU, enhancing performance and overclocking potential. Strong memory support is provided by the four DIMM slots, which enable AMD EXPO and Intel XMP memory modules in addition to dual-channel DDR5 memory. This guarantees that memory performance is optimum for intensive workloads. The motherboard has two PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 and one PCIe 5.0 x4 M.2 connection for storage, providing extremely fast data transmission and quick system responsiveness. The motherboard has a superior thermal design with an M.2 Thermal Guard to avoid thermal throttling of 25110 M.2 SSDs and provide VRM power stability, allowing for maximum performance. The PCIe x16 slot and M.2 connections' EZ-Latch design, which enables fast release and screwless installation, emphasizes ease of usage. GIGABYTE B650 EAGLE AX DDR5 AM5 Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650 EAGLE AX DDR5 AM5 Motherboard is designed to support AMD's latest Ryzen 7000 and 8000 series processors, offering unparalleled performance for both gaming and professional applications. This motherboard features a robust 12+2+2 phase digital VRM solution, ensuring stable power delivery and efficient performance under heavy workloads. With its dual-channel DDR5 memory support, the board includes 4 SMD DIMM slots compatible with AMD EXPO and Intel XMP memory modules, providing enhanced performance and flexibility. The motherboard's SuperSpeed storage features, which include two PCIe 4.0 M.2 and one PCIe 5.0 M.2 connection, allow for quick data access and transfer. VRM power stability and excellent performance for 25110 M.2 SSDs are guaranteed by its sophisticated thermal design, which includes an M.2 thermal protection. With its rapid-release design and hassle-free maintenance and upgrades, the EZ-Latch PCIe x16 slot makes expansion simple. Gigabit Ethernet LAN for dependable wired networking and Wi-Fi 6E 802.11ax for quick wireless connectivity are examples of networking capabilities. GIGABYTE B650 UD AC AM5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650 UD AC is a high-performance ATX motherboard designed for AMD's latest processors, utilizing the AM5 socket to support AMD Ryzen 7000, 8000, and 9000 series processors. It offers robust performance and advanced features suitable for gaming and professional applications. The motherboard features a 6+2+2 phases digital VRM solution, ensuring stable and efficient power delivery, even under heavy loads, which supports overclocking and maintains system stability. It supports dual-channel DDR5 memory with four SMD DIMM slots, accommodating high-speed RAM modules and offering AMD EXPO and Intel XMP profiles for easy overclocking. The B650 UD AC includes one PCIe 5.0 M.2 slot and two PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots, providing ultra-fast data transfer rates and improved system responsiveness. The EZ-Latch PCIe x16 slot simplifies the installation and removal of graphics cards with a quick-release design. Network connectivity is ensured through built-in Wi-Fi 802.11ac and a Gigabit Ethernet LAN port, offering fast and reliable options for online gaming and streaming. The motherboard also includes DisplayPort and HDMI outputs, supporting high-resolution displays and multiple monitor setups. The rear I/O features high-speed USB 10Gb/s ports for quick data transfers and peripheral connectivity. The Smart Fan 6 technology provides comprehensive cooling management with multiple temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers, including a FAN STOP function for quieter operation. The Q-Flash Plus feature allows users to update the BIOS without needing to install a CPU, memory, or graphics card, simplifying firmware updates. Overall, the GIGABYTE B650 UD AC is a well-rounded motherboard offering high-end features and connectivity for building a powerful and future-proof PC, making it an excellent choice for gamers, content creators, and enthusiasts alike.

products.description:
GIGABYTE B650 UD AX AMD AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650 UD AX AMD AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard is a high-performance platform designed to support the latest AMD Ryzen 7000, 8000, and 9000 Series processors using the advanced AM5 socket. Built on the AMD B650 chipset and ATX form factor, GIGABYTE AMD Motherboard delivers exceptional speed, connectivity, and expandability for gamers, content creators, and professionals. It supports up to 256 gigabytes of DDR5 memory across four DIMM slots, with speeds reaching up to 8000 megatransfers per second when overclocked. The dual-channel memory architecture is compatible with AMD EXPO and Intel XMP profiles, enabling seamless overclocking and optimized performance for demanding applications. For graphics and expansion, the GIGABYTE AMD ATX Motherboard includes one PCI Express 4.0 x16 slot integrated into the CPU, ideal for high-end graphics cards or NVMe solid-state drives. Additional PCI Express 3.0 x1 slots provide flexibility for add-on cards, although availability may vary depending on the installed processor. Integrated graphics support includes DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.1 outputs, capable of delivering 4K resolution at high refresh rates for immersive visual experiences. Connectivity is future-ready with Realtek RTL8851 WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0, offering fast and stable wireless networking across dual 2.4 and 5 gigahertz bands. Wired networking is powered by the Realtek RTL8111H Gigabit LAN chip, ensuring reliable and high-speed Ethernet performance. The rear input and output panel features a wide range of ports, including USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A, USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C, USB 2.0, RJ-45 LAN, audio jacks, and legacy PS2 support for keyboard and mouse. Storage options are extensive, with three M.2 connectors supporting PCI Express 5.0 and 4.0 SSDs, depending on CPU compatibility, and four SATA 6 gigabits per second connectors for traditional drives. The GIGABYTE B650 UD AX supports RAID 0, RAID 1, and RAID 10 configurations for both NVMe and SATA devices, offering flexibility in performance and data redundancy. Audio is powered by the Realtek ALC897 codec, delivering high-definition 7.1-channel surround sound. Users can customize audio jack functionality through bundled software, ensuring optimal sound configuration for gaming, media consumption, or professional audio tasks. Internally, the GIGABYTE B650 UD AX includes a comprehensive array of headers and connectors such as RGB and addressable RGB Gen2 LED strip headers, multiple fan and pump headers for advanced cooling setups, USB 3.2 Gen 1 and USB 2.0 headers, TPM support, and a Q-Flash Plus button for easy BIOS updates. The BIOS is a licensed AMI UEFI interface with support for ACPI 5.0, DMI 2.7, and other advanced standards. Software support includes Windows 10 and Windows 11 64-bit editions, bundled Norton Internet Security OEM version, and GIGABYTE Control Center for system monitoring, RGB control, and performance tuning. Hardware monitoring features include voltage, temperature, fan speed, and water cooling flow rate detection, with fail warnings and speed control options. Measuring 30.5 centimeters by 24.4 centimeters, the ATX form factor ensures compatibility with a wide range of cases and cooling solutions. Whether building a next-generation gaming PC, a content creation powerhouse, or a future-ready workstation, the GIGABYTE B650 UD AX delivers the reliability, speed, and flexibility needed for modern computing.

GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX ICE DDR5 AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX ICE DDR5 AMD AM5 mATX Motherboard is a premium platform built for gamers and creators who demand speed, stability, and advanced features. Powered by the AMD B650 chipset, this GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX ICE DDR5 Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 7000, 8000, and 9000 Series processors on the AM5 socket. With DDR5 memory support, PCIe 5.0 storage, and Wi-Fi 6E, this Gigabyte B650M White Motherboard delivers next-generation performance in a stylish micro ATX design.

Memory, Graphics, and Expansion

The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX ICE micro atx Motherboard supports up to 256GB DDR5 memory with speeds reaching 8000+ MT/s (OC), offering extreme bandwidth for multitasking and gaming. Integrated AMD Radeon graphics provide 4K resolution via DisplayPort 1.4 at 144Hz and HDMI 2.1 at 60Hz. Expansion options include PCIe 4.0 x16 and PCIe 4.0 x4 slots, ensuring compatibility with modern GPUs and add-in cards. This GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX ICE DDR5 Motherboard is engineered for performance-driven builds with advanced overclocking support.

Connectivity and Features

Networking is powered by Realtek 2.5GbE LAN and Wi-Fi 6E with Bluetooth 5.3, ensuring ultra-fast connections. Storage options include dual M.2 slots supporting PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSDs, plus four SATA 6Gb/s connectors with RAID support. USB connectivity is extensive, featuring USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C, multiple USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 1 ports, and legacy USB 2.0 support. Enhanced with Realtek HD Audio, RGB headers, EZ Debug LEDs, and TPM 2.0 support, the Gigabyte B650M White Motherboard combines speed, security, and customization for modern gaming and productivity setups.

GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX DDR5 AMD AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors for socket AM5. It equips the best VRM design ever built with the highest quality components and comes with direct 12+2+1 Phases Digital VRM Solution. It offers advanced thermal heatsinks to improve thermal efficiency with better airflow and heat exchange. It comes with 2x PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 Connectors. The M.2 Thermal Guard prevents throttling and bottlenecks from high-speed M.2 SSDs as it helps to dissipate heat before it becomes an issue. This motherboard features 2X copper PCBs design effectively lowering the component temperature through its high thermal conductivity and low impedance. The Smart Fan 6 contains several unique cooling features that ensure the gaming PC maintains its performance while staying cool and quiet. Each fan headers support PWM and DC fan and Water Cooling Pump, and up to 24W (12V x 2A) with Over-Current Protection. The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX Motherboard comes with 2.5G LAN which provides up to 2.5 GbE network connectivity, with at least 2 times faster transfer speeds compared to general 1GbE networking. It also supports Multi-Gig(10/100/1000/2500Mbps) RJ-45 Ethernet. The USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports provide speeds up to 10Gbps. With twice the bandwidth compared to its previous generation, The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS ELITE AX Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

GIGABYTE B650M AORUS PRO AX DDR5 AMD AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS PRO AX Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors for socket AM5. It equips the best VRM design ever built with the highest quality components and comes with direct 12+2+1 Phases Digital VRM Solution. It offers advanced thermal heatsinks to improve thermal efficiency with better airflow and heat exchange. It comes with 2x PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 Connectors. The M.2 Thermal Guard prevents throttling and bottlenecks from high-speed M.2 SSDs as it helps to dissipate heat before it becomes an issue. This motherboard features 2X copper PCBs design effectively lowering the component temperature through its high thermal conductivity and low impedance. The Smart Fan 6 contains several unique cooling features that ensure the gaming PC maintains its performance while staying cool and quiet. Each fan headers support PWM and DC fan and Water Cooling Pump, and up to 24W (12V x 2A) with Over-Current Protection. The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS PRO AX Motherboard comes with 2.5G LAN which provides up to 2.5 GbE network connectivity, with at least 2 times faster transfer speeds compared to general 1GbE networking. It also supports Multi-Gig(10/100/1000/2500Mbps) RJ-45 Ethernet. The USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports provide speeds up to 10Gbps. With twice the bandwidth compared to its previous generation, The GIGABYTE B650M AORUS PRO AX Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

GIGABYTE B650M D3HP AX DDR5 AM5 Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650M D3HP AX DDR5 AM5 Motherboard is the latest platform that will elevate your computer experience. This motherboard's robust design ensures seamless performance for a wide range of applications, and it works with Ryzen 8000 and 7000 Series Processors for Socket AM5. The GIGABYTE B650M D3HP AX, equipped with the newest DDR5 memory technology, can overclock to 7600MHz and accommodate up to 192GB of RAM distributed across 4 DDR5 slots. This ensures smooth multitasking and lightning-fast response. This motherboard provides flexible graphics output choices for improved display setups, whether you're gaming, streaming, or working on multimedia projects. It is equipped with two Display Ports and one HDMI connector. Packed with features designed to maximize performance and connection is the GIGABYTE B650M D3HP AX. Fast and dependable network connections are ensured by its Realtek 2.5GbE LAN for high-speed wired networking and Realtek Wi-Fi 6E RTL8852CE for wireless connectivity. The 5+2+2 Phases Digital VRM Solution delivers unmatched performance and dependable power supply to your components—even when they are under severe loads. Memory speed and bandwidth are further improved by the Dual Channel DDR5 support, which includes 4*SMD DIMMs with AMD EXPO & Intel XMP Memory Module Support. The PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 Connector raises the bar for storage capacity by providing SuperSpeed storage options for fast data transmission speeds. For even more convenience, the EZ-Latch PCIe x16 Slot with Quick Release Design makes hardware installation and removal simpler. Maintain connectivity and take advantage of swift network speeds with 2.5GbE LAN and Wi-Fi 6E 802.11ax. A large variety of devices and peripherals are compatible with the extended connectivity choices, which include two Display connectors and HDMI connectors. With its various temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers with FAN STOP technology, Smart Fan 6 offers intelligent cooling that maximizes thermal performance while reducing noise. Without requiring the installation of the CPU, RAM, or graphics card, the Q-Flash Plus function makes it easy to update the BIOS, simplifying the procedure for more comfort and assurance. Designed to satisfy the needs of modern computing, the GIGABYTE B650M D3HP AX DDR5 AM5 Motherboard is a powerful solution that provides unmatched performance, connection, and simplicity for both enthusiasts and professionals.

GIGABYTE B650M GAMING X AX DDR5 AM5 Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B650M GAMING X AX Motherboard is a powerhouse designed to cater to the demands of gaming enthusiasts and professionals seeking top-tier performance and reliability. It seamlessly supports the latest Ryzen 8000/7000 Series Processors with its Socket AM5, making it a future-proof cornerstone for any high-performance gaming setup. The motherboard distinguishes itself with support for up to 192GB of DDR5 RAM across four slots, capable of reaching speeds up to 8000MHz when overclocked. This vast and speedy memory support is further enhanced by compatibility with AMD EXPO and Intel XMP, ensuring easy and stable overclocking for peak performance. Strong visual output is offered by two Display Ports and one HDMI connector, offering a variety of high-definition connectivity choices for immersive gaming or multiple monitor configurations. The motherboard's core technology is a Direct 6+2+1 Phases Digital VRM Solution, which has been painstakingly designed to provide reliable and effective power distribution to crucial system components under a range of load scenarios. The dual-channel DDR5 architecture perfectly complements the high-performance CPUs it supports by increasing system speed and bandwidth. including two PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 connections for super-fast storage, which drastically cuts down on game load times and guarantees quick data access. Additionally, GIGABYTE has given thermal management a lot of thought. To maintain ideal temperatures and avoid performance throttling during demanding gaming sessions or high workload activities, the company has included an M.2 Thermal Guard coupled with an innovative thermal design. The EZ-Latch design on the PCIe x16 slot and M.2 connections, which enables rapid and tool-free component installation or upgrades, is proof that ease of use is a top priority. With both 2.5GbE LAN and Wi-Fi 6E 802.11ax available, the networking capabilities are state-of-the-art, guaranteeing dependable and fast internet connections whether connected cable or wirelessly. A variety of connectors, such as two Display connectors, two USB-C 10Gb/s, and HDMI, enable extended connectivity and can support a large number of external devices and peripherals. Smart Fan 6 technology monitors temperature with hybrid fan headers and the FAN STOP feature, ensuring silent and economical operation. The GIGABYTE B760M D3HP DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard is powered by a long-lasting Hybrid 4+1+1 Phase Digital VRM Solution, which provides consistent and clean power for steady performance. The GIGABYTE B760M D3HP DDR5 Motherboard is an excellent choice for gaming, productivity, and future-ready PC setups, thanks to its powerful features, contemporary connections, and extensive CPU and memory compatibility.

GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 mATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 mATX Motherboard is a powerful and compact option for gamers, creators, and professionals seeking modern capabilities without sacrificing stability or performance. Built with the Intel B760 Express chipset, it supports 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron CPUs via the LGA1700 socket, making it ideal for a variety of designs. Memory support is future-ready, with four DDR5 DIMM ports supporting up to 256GB capacity and overclocking rates of up to DDR5-7600 when combined with high-end processors. The GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 Motherboard also supports dual-channel architecture, ECC and non-ECC modules, and Intel XMP profiles for smooth overclocking. Graphics are handled by integrated Intel HD Graphics, which supports HDMI 2.1 with resolutions of up to 4K at 60Hz and multiple DisplayPort outputs, allowing for triple-display setups for productivity and enjoyment. The Realtek codec improves audio quality by enabling up to 7.1-channel HD sound with S/PDIF output, providing an immersive experience. With Realtek 2.5GbE LAN and Intel Wi-Fi 6E AX210 module, the GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 Motherboard provides Wi-Fi 6E connection across 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands, as well as Bluetooth 5.3 for current wireless devices. Storage options include two M.2 PCIe 4.0 x4 connectors for NVMe SSDs and four SATA 6Gb/s ports with RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 support, allowing for high-speed and redundant storage configurations. Expansion is robust, with one PCIe 5.0 x16 port for next-generation GPUs and two PCIe 3.0 x1 slots for add-on cards. The GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 Motherboard's rear panel features USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-C, USB 3.2 Gen1, USB 2.0, HDMI, DisplayPort, RJ-45 LAN and audio ports, as well as Wi-Fi antenna connectors. Other features include RGB and ARGB headers, Q-Flash Plus for simple BIOS updates, fan monitoring, Smart Backup, and support for GIGABYTE Control Center software. With Windows 10 and 11 compatibility and a micro ATX form factor of 24.4cm x 24.4cm, the GIGABYTE B760M DS3H WIFI6E GEN5 is a dependable motherboard that combines performance, connectivity, and expandability for modern PC designs.

GIGABYTE B850 EAGLE WIFI6E AMD AM5 DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B850 EAGLE WIFI6E AMD AM5 DDR5 motherboard is a high-performance ATX motherboard designed for gamers, content creators, and PC enthusiasts. It supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series CPUs on the AM5 socket, delivering top-tier performance with next-generation processing capability. The GIGABYTE AMD AM5 motherboard has four DDR5 DIMM slots that can support up to 256GB of RAM at speeds of up to 8200 MT/s when overclocked, providing excellent multitasking and gaming performance. Users can maximize system memory efficiency by using AMD EXPO and XMP memory modules. The GIGABYTE B850 EAGLE WIFI6E AM5 motherboard has PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 slots for graphics cards and NVMe SSDs, which ensures fast data transfer rates and expandable storage. It has three M.2 slots and four SATA 6Gb/s ports, with RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 compatibility for both NVMe and SATA storage. Realtek GbE LAN, Intel Wi-Fi 6E, and Bluetooth 5.3 ensure high-speed networking and flawless wireless performance. The GIGABYTE B850 EAGLE WIFI6E motherboard has several USB ports, including USB 3.2 Gen 2 and USB Type-C, for quick data transfer. Onboard graphics compatibility includes DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.1, which can produce 4K visuals at high refresh rates. The Realtek audio codec delivers high-definition 7.1-channel sound for a fully immersive experience. Additionally, the GIGABYTE DDR5 motherboard includes multiple RGB and ARGB connectors, fan and water pump ports, and Q-Flash Plus for simple BIOS updates. It also has innovative cooling solutions, voltage monitoring, and smart fan management to maintain system stability. The GIGABYTE B850 EAGLE WIFI6E motherboard, which is compatible with Windows 10 and 11, is a feature-rich motherboard that provides current PC setups with performance, expandability, and durability.

GIGABYTE B850M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E ICE AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B850M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E ICE is a high-performance AMD AM5 Micro ATX motherboard with impressive features and excellent connections. It supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 processors, providing ample computational capability for gaming and productivity. Built on the AMD B850 chipset, it can support up to 256GB of DDR5 memory at speeds of up to 8200MHz and is overclockable with AMD EXPO and XMP profiles. The GIGABYTE B850M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E ICE AM5 Motherboard features integrated AMD Radeon graphics, a DisplayPort that supports 4K resolution at 144Hz, and a front HDMI port. Realtek High Definition Audio provides 7.1-channel capability and S/PDIF output. Realtek 2.5GbE LAN and Realtek Wi-Fi 6E with Bluetooth 5.3 enable quick and stable connectivity. The motherboard has comprehensive USB connectivity, including a rear USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C port, several USB 3.2 Gen 1 and USB 2.0 ports, and internal headers for front-panel connections. Furthermore, the GIGABYTE B850M AORUS ELITE WIFI6E ICE AM5 Micro ATX Motherboard includes customized RGB illumination with addressable Gen2 LED strip headers, Smart Fan controls, multiple system fan headers, and Q-Flash Plus compatibility for BIOS upgrades without a CPU.

GIGABYTE B850M D3HP AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B850M D3HP is a powerful AMD AM5 Micro ATX motherboard that provides a good balance of power, expandability, and durability. It is compatible with AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors, providing a stable base for gaming and professional applications. With four DDR5 DIMM slots, it can accommodate up to 256GB of RAM at speeds of up to 8200MHz, offering high-speed performance and overclocking capability with AMD EXPO and XMP. The GIGABYTE B850M D3HP DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard features integrated AMD Radeon graphics with HDMI 2.1 and dual DisplayPort outputs, allowing for resolutions of up to 4K at 144Hz and triple-display capabilities. The GIGABYTE B850 Motherboard features two M.2 slots for PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 SSDs, as well as four SATA 6Gb/s connections with RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 compatibility. Expansion slots include a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for graphics cards and a PCIe 3.0 x4 slot for extra devices. Realtek GbE LAN provides robust wired connectivity. The GIGABYTE B850M D3HP AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard has several USB ports, including USB 3.2 Gen 1 and USB Type-C connectors on the back and front panel headers. RGB customization is possible using addressable Gen2 LED strip headers. Smart Fan controls, Q-Flash Plus for quick BIOS updates, and Windows 11 compatibility are among the other features. The GIGABYTE B850M D3HP AM5 Micro ATX Motherboard has a compact form factor and offers robust performance, comprehensive connections, and upgrade potential, making it an excellent choice for gaming, content creation, and productivity-focused systems.

products.description:
GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E AM5 Motherboard is a next-generation Micro ATX motherboard engineered for enthusiasts, gamers, and professionals seeking high-end performance with future-ready connectivity. Designed for AMD Socket AM5, it supports the latest AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, unlocking extreme multitasking and gaming capabilities. This advanced GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard features four DDR5 memory slots, supporting up to 256GB of RAM with speeds up to DDR5 8200 MHz (OC). With full support for AMD EXPO and Intel XMP profiles, it ensures seamless overclocking and memory optimization across dual-channel architecture. For high-speed storage, the motherboard includes two M.2 PCIe slots—one supporting PCIe 5.0 x4 and the other PCIe 4.0 x4/x2—making it ideal for blazing-fast NVMe SSDs. It also includes four SATA 6Gb/s ports with RAID 0, 1, 5 (exclusive to Ryzen 9000), and 10 support, delivering reliable storage redundancy and performance. The GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E Motherboard also boasts advanced display outputs, including 2x DisplayPorts (up to 3840x2160@144Hz) and 1x HDMI 2.1 port (4096x2160@60Hz), supporting up to triple-display output, perfect for multitasking or immersive visuals. Connectivity is cutting-edge, with onboard Intel Wi-Fi 6E (Realtek RTL8852CE) supporting 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands, Bluetooth 5.3, and a Realtek 2.5GbE LAN port, ensuring ultra-low latency for both wired and wireless networking. Expansion slots include a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for high-end GPUs (when paired with Ryzen 9000/7000 CPUs) and a secondary PCIe 3.0 x4 slot. The board also features a rich I/O panel with a USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C port, USB 3.2 Gen 1, USB 2.0, PS/2 port, 3 audio jacks, and antenna connectors, complemented by multiple internal headers for additional USB, ARGB Gen2, RGB LED strips, fans, and water cooling systems. The GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E AM5 DDR5 Motherboard supports Q-Flash, Q-Flash Plus, Smart Backup, and is fully compatible with the GIGABYTE Control Center (GCC) software, allowing users to monitor, control, and optimize system performance with ease. High-definition audio is delivered through the Realtek Audio Codec, with support for configurable 2/4/5.1/7.1-channel sound. Measuring 24.4cm x 24.4cm, this Micro ATX board is compact yet feature-packed, making it perfect for high-performance builds in smaller enclosures. Whether you're building a next-gen gaming PC or a workstation, the GIGABYTE B850M EAGLE WIFI6E AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard is a powerful and future-proof choice designed to deliver exceptional performance, reliability, and connectivity.

GIGABYTE B850M GAMING X WIFI6E AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE B850M GAMING X WIFI6E motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 processors with the AM5 socket. With four DDR5 DIMM slots, it can accommodate up to 256GB of RAM at rates of up to 8200 MT/s when overclocked, delivering outstanding memory bandwidth for demanding workloads. Users can use AMD EXPO and XMP profiles to optimize system memory for greater stability and speed. The GIGABYTE B850M GAMING X WIFI6E AM5 Micro ATX Motherboard has PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 expansion slots, making it excellent for high-performance GPUs and NVMe SSDs. Storage options include two M.2 slots for PCIe 5.0 and PCIe 4.0 SSDs, as well as four SATA 6Gb/s connections with RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 support for improved data redundancy and performance. HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 are supported by the integrated graphics, enabling for up to three displays with high refresh rates. The GIGABYTE B850M GAMING X WIFI6E Motherboard's Realtek 2.5GbE LAN and Wi-Fi 6E with Bluetooth 5.3 enable fast networking for flawless online gaming and streaming. Multiple USB 3.2 Gen 2 and USB Type-C connections enable quick data transfers and peripheral connectivity. A Realtek audio codec powers high-definition audio, which supports 7.1-channel surround sound. GIGABYTE B850M GAMING X WIFI6E AMD AM5 DDR5 Micro ATX Motherboard also includes sophisticated cooling solutions, various RGB headers, and support for GIGABYTE Control Center, which allows for simple system customization.

GIGABYTE motherboards feature an audio noise guard that essentially separates the boardâ€™s sensitive analog audio components from potential noise pollution at the PCB level.

ULTRA-DURABLE

Sulfur compounds in the air can penetrate tiny onboard resistors creating chemical change and causing these resistors to open or short. If either of these occurs the motherboard will fail to function. By equipping resistors with an Anti-Sulfur Design GIGABYTE gives Ultra Durable Motherboards a whole new meaning. GIGABYTE motherboards also feature special anti-surge IC that protect your motherboard, helping to ensure that your PC is equipped to deal with any potentially irregular electrical spikes. GIGABYTE motherboards have been designed to make sure that humidity is never an issue, incorporating a new Glass Fabric PCB technology that repels moisture caused by humid and damp conditions. Glass Fabric PCB technology uses a new PCB material that reduces the amount of space between the fiber weave, making it much more difficult for moisture to penetrate compared to traditional motherboard PCBs. This offers much better protection from short circuits and system malfunction caused by humid and damp conditions. GIGABYTE motherboards use Low RDS(on) MOSFETs which reduce energy wastage through unnecessary residual heat dissipation. This all amounts to tangible energy savings which are beneficial for both end-users and the environment without impacting system performance.

Additionally, the motherboard delivers superior audio quality with Realtek ALC1220 HD Audio and WIMA audiophile-grade capacitors, ensuring an immersive audio experience. Overall, the GIGABYTE X870 AORUS ELITE WIFI7 DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard is the ultimate choice for those seeking to unleash the full potential of their system with advanced memory support, robust power delivery, efficient cooling solutions, and extensive connectivity options

GIGABYTE X870E AORUS ELITE WIFI7 DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE X870E AORUS ELITE WIFI7 DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard is a high-performance motherboard designed to support AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors, leveraging the power of the AMD Socket AM5 and advanced DDR5 memory technology. With four DIMM slots supporting dual-channel DDR5 memory and AMD EXPO™ Memory Module Support, it offers overclocking capabilities up to 8600MT/s, ensuring top-tier performance and compatibility. The user-friendly design includes M.2 EZ-Match magnetic alignment, EZ-Latch Plus for PCIe and M.2 slots, and a friendly UI with multi-theme support, making installation and management a breeze. Additionally, the motherboard delivers superior audio quality with Realtek ALC1220 HD Audio and WIMA audiophile-grade capacitors, ensuring an immersive audio experience. Overall, the GIGABYTE X870E AORUS ELITE WIFI7 DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard is the ultimate choice for those seeking to unleash the full potential of their system with advanced memory support, robust power delivery, efficient cooling solutions, and extensive connectivity options
