GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS MASTER E-ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS MASTER E-ATX Motherboard comes with Intel Socket LGA 1700 that supports 14th 13th and 12th Gen Series Processors. It comes with a direct 20+1+2 Phases Digital VRM Solution. The motherboard comes with 4x SMD DIMMs with XMP 3.0 Memory Module Support. It offers support for DDR5 8000(O.C) / 7950(O.C) / 7900(O.C) / 7800(O.C) / 7600(O.C.) / 7400(O.C.) / 7200(O.C.) / 7000(O.C.) / 6800(O.C.) / 6600(O.C.) / 6400(O.C.) / 6200(O.C.) / 6000(O.C.) / 5800(O.C.) / 5600(O.C.) / 5400(O.C.) / 5200(O.C.) / 4800 / 4000 memory modules. The sockets support up to 128 GB (32 GB single DIMM capacity) of system memory. The motherboard has 1x PCIe 5.0 x4 and 4x PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 Connectors. PCIe 5.0 Design supports double the bandwidth of PCIe 4.0 and ensures that compatible with cutting-edge SSDs and GPUs. The M.2 Thermal Guard III is constructed with a 9X optimized heat dissipation surface and double-sided M.2 heatsinks to prevent throttling and bottlenecks on high-speed/ large capacity PCIe 5.0 M.2 SSDs. The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS MASTER is equipped with the latest Wireless solution 802.11ax Wi-Fi 6E with a new dedicated 6GHz band, enabling gigabit wireless performance. The Marvell AQtion AQC113C is a high-performance, backward compatible with 10GBASE-T/ 5GBASE-T/ 2.5GBASE-T/ 1000BASE-T/ 100BASE-TX Ethernet Controller which is able to provide up to 10 GbE network connectivity. The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS MASTER E-ATX Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS MASTER X E-ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS MASTER X E-ATX Motherboard is a high-end motherboard built for gamers and enthusiasts who want exceptional performance. This motherboard is compatible with Intel Core 14th and 13th generation processors, guaranteeing that it is ready for Intel's latest and best CPUs. The motherboard features a strong 20+1+2 power phase architecture that ensures optimal power supply to your CPU for optimum performance and stability. With 4 DIMM slots and XMP 3.0 memory module compatibility, you may experience lightning-fast memory speeds and enough capacity for multitasking and gaming. This motherboard has a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot with 10X strength for your graphics card, which provides enough bandwidth for the newest GPUs while also future-proofing your system. M.2 heatsinks with screwless designs make it simple to install and cool your M.2 NVMe SSDs, assuring maximum performance. The PCIe 5.0 x16 slot and M.2 slots have a quick-release design that makes hardware installation and upgrades easier. The user-centered BIOS interface provides a straightforward user experience with a Quick Access option, allowing users to adjust and optimize their system settings more easily. You may experience very high storage speeds for your games, programs, and data with five M.2 slots, including one PCIe 5.0 x4 slot. The VRM Thermal Armor Fins-Array and M.2 Thermal Guard XL assist in heat dissipation, keeping your system cool and stable even during strenuous workloads. The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS MASTER X Motherboard has a 10GbE LAN and Wi-Fi 7, as well as an ultra-high gain antenna, for lightning-fast and dependable network access. You have plenty of connectivity choices for all your peripherals and devices with DisplayPort, a front USB-C connector with 10Gb/s transfer rates, and front and twin rear USB-C ports with 20Gb/s transfer speeds. The audio capabilities of the motherboard are excellent, with the ALC1220 audio codec and a back ESS SABRE Hi-Fi 9118 DAC providing high-quality sound for gaming and entertainment.

The 14th Gen motherboard is equipped with the PCIe 5.0 x16 slot and M.2 socket designed to optimize multitasking and large workloads, which is also ready for a new PCIe 5.0 graphics card or storage device. It supports new PCIe 5.0 SSD with up to type 25110 M.2 slot designed to provide high power M.2 PCIe 5.0 SSD solutions. The GIGABYTE Z790 D DDR4 is equipped with Intel 2.5Gb Ethernet provides an immediate boost to overall network performance, smooth video editing, and fast data transfers. The advanced cooling solution also provides the perfect aesthetic heatsink design to keep your PC at an optimal temperature, preventing you from unexpected system crashes during the creative process. The GIGABYTE Z790 D DDR4 ATX Motherboard comes with 3 years of warranty.

products.description:
GIGABYTE Z790 D DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE Z790 D DDR5 ATX motherboard is a high-performance platform with several sophisticated features designed to enhance system performance, stability, and connection for both gaming and professional applications. It is compatible with Intel's 14th, 13th, and 12th-generation Core CPUs. In addition to a dual 12+1+1 phases digital VRM solution that ensures robust and consistent power delivery to the CPU, it boasts a 6+6 phases parallel power architecture for efficient and reliable power management. The motherboard features four DIMM slots, supports dual-channel DDR5 memory, and offers XMP 3.0, which simplifies memory module optimization and overclocking. The Z790 D's three PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 storage ports allow for next-generation storage solutions with rapid access times and high data transfer rates. Its cutting-edge thermal design, which incorporates M.2 Thermal Guards, keeps the VRM and M.2 SSDs operating at stable temperatures and guarantees their steady performance. The quick-release design of the EZ-Latch PCIe 4.0 x16 slot makes it easier to install or remove graphics cards. A 2.5GbE LAN connection improves networking by offering dependable and quick connectivity for data transfers and games. Numerous back I/O choices include a rear USB-C 10Gb/s connector for fast data transmission and peripheral access, as well as DisplayPort and HDMI outputs for flexible display connectivity. Multiple temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers with a FAN STOP function are components of the Smart Fan 6 technology, which improves cooling and lowers noise levels. The Q-Flash Plus feature allows users to update the BIOS without the need to install the CPU, memory, or graphics card, simplifying maintenance and setup. The GIGABYTE Z790 D DDR5 ATX motherboard is ideal for enthusiasts and professionals who demand high performance, extensive connectivity options, and advanced features to support their computing needs.

products.description:
GIGABYTE Z790 EAGLE AX DDR5 ATX Motherboard

The GIGABYTE Z790 EAGLE AX motherboard is a high-performance platform ideal for demanding applications like gaming and content production. It is designed to accommodate the latest 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen Intel CPUs using the LGA1700 socket. It provides fast and efficient performance for demanding tasks and multitasking, with four DIMM slots supporting up to 192GB of DDR5 memory and speeds up to 7600 MHz (overclocked). Its display connection options include DisplayPort and HDMI outputs. A strong Twin 12*+1+1 Phases Digital VRM Solution, which offers steady and dependable power delivery and is necessary to sustain performance under high loads, is one of the GIGABYTE Z790 EAGLE AX's key characteristics. Dual-channel DDR5 with XMP 3.0 Memory Modules is supported by the motherboard, enhancing memory performance and stability. With three PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 connections, there are many storage options and fast data transmission and large storage capacity. In addition to preventing SSD overheating, the M.2 Thermal Guard and sophisticated thermal design guarantee VRM power stability. The quick-release design of the EZ-Latch PCIe 5.0 x16 slot facilitates installation simplicity and makes graphics card upgrades simple. Thanks to Intel Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax) and Realtek 2.5GbE LAN, networking is dependable and quick. In addition, the motherboard offers a wide range of connectivity choices, such as DisplayPort, HDMI, and a rear USB-C connector that supports 10Gb/s data transmission. With its various temperature sensors and hybrid fan headers with FAN STOP technology, the Smart Fan 6 feature provides sophisticated cooling solutions that are specifically matched to the requirements of the system. The update procedure is made simpler by the Q-Flash Plus function, which enables BIOS upgrades without requiring the installation of the CPU, RAM, or graphics card. For those looking for a reliable and feature-rich motherboard that supports the newest Intel CPUs and cutting-edge technology and offers exceptional performance and dependability for any high-end computing demands, the GIGABYTE Z790 EAGLE AX is a great option.

Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X LGA1851 Micro ATX Motherboard

The Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X Micro ATX Motherboard is an Ultra Powerful motherboard designed to support Intel Core Ultra processors with an LGA1851 socket. Featuring the Intel Z890 Express Chipset, this Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X Motherboard offers exceptional performance and DDR5 memory support, with memory speeds ranging from 6400 MT/s to 9066 MT/s across 4 x DIMM slots, supporting up to 256 GB of system memory. It also supports dual-channel memory architecture, ECC and non-ECC un-buffered DIMMs, and Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) modules for high-speed memory configurations. For integrated graphics, the Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X motherboard includes HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 2.1 outputs, supporting triple-display setups at resolutions up to 4096x2304 @60 Hz with HDCP 2.3 compatibility. Powered by a Realtek Audio CODEC, it delivers high-definition audio with support for 2/4/5.1/7.1-channel configurations and includes a Realtek® 2.5GbE LAN chip for fast, reliable networking. The Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X Motherboard also offers extensive expansion options, with a PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for graphics cards or NVMe SSDs, a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot running at x4 for additional expansion, and multiple M.2 connectors supporting PCIe 4.0/5.0 SSDs along with four SATA 6Gb/s connectors, supporting RAID for both NVMe and SATA devices. Featuring a wide range of internal and external I/O connectors, including USB 3.2 Gen 1, USB Type-C, fan headers for cooling, addressable RGB lighting, and Thunderbolt add-in card connectors, the Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X motherboard is highly customizable. It’s compatible with Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) and uses a 256 Mbit flash BIOS with AMI UEFI BIOS, offering an intuitive interface for advanced configuration. The Micro ATX form factor (24.4cm x 24.4cm) makes the Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X Micro ATX Motherboard perfect for compact PC builds without compromising on performance. Whether for gaming or professional use, the Gigabyte Z890M GAMING X Motherboard delivers unbeatable features and future-proof capabilities, making it the ideal choice for building a high-performance gaming rig or workstation.

System diagnostics and monitoring capabilities include 4x EZ Debug LEDs and an EZ Memory Detection LED for simplified troubleshooting and system status verification. MSI B850M GAMING WIFI7 AM5 mATX Motherboard

The MSI B850M GAMING WIFI AM5 mATX Motherboard is built for AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors on the AM5 socket. This Motherboard runs on the AMD B850 chipset and supports two DDR5 UDIMM slots with a maximum capacity of 128GB. DDR5 memory speeds reach up to 8200 MT/s via overclocking, with JEDEC speeds supported from 4800 to 5600 MT/s for broad compatibility. AMD EXPO and dual-channel memory support maximize bandwidth and performance across all supported Ryzen processor generations.

The MSI B850M GAMING WIFI AM5 Motherboard features a primary PCIe 5.0 x16 slot delivering up to 128GB/s bandwidth for next-generation GPU performance. A secondary PCIe 4.0 x4 slot from the chipset provides additional expansion capability for other peripherals and cards. Two M.2 slots include M.2_1 supporting PCIe 5.0 x4 from the CPU and M.2_2 supporting PCIe 4.0 x4 for ultra-fast NVMe storage. Both M.2 slots benefit from M.2 Shield Frozr thermal protection that prevents throttling and keeps SSDs running at peak speeds.

The MSI B850M GAMING WIFI mATX Motherboard has four SATA 6G ports support RAID 0, 1, and 10 configurations for flexible traditional storage setups. The MSI WIFI7 Motherboard includes a pre-installed Wi-Fi 7 module supporting 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz bands at up to 2.9Gbps with Bluetooth 5.4, MLO, and 4KQAM. A Realtek 8126 5G LAN controller delivers premium wired network performance for low-latency gaming and streaming.

Onboard graphics output includes HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4, both supporting up to 4K 60Hz resolution. This MSI B850M GAMING WIFI AMD Motherboard has realtek ALC897 powers 7.1-channel HD audio for immersive studio-grade sound quality. The MSI AMD AM5 Motherboard features four EZ Debug LEDs and one EZ Memory Detection LED for simplified hardware troubleshooting. An extended PWM heatsink and enhanced circuit design keep even high-end processors running at full speed consistently. The MSI mATX Motherboard measures 226×243.84mm and fully supports Windows 11 64-bit operating systems.

products.name: MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard
products.description:
MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard

MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 Motherboard supports 12th/ 13th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors for LGA 1700 socket. It comes with four dual-channel RAM slots, and three M.2 slots allowing you to take advantage of the full power of 13th & 12th generation Intel processors. The Six SATA III ports allow users to create large storage drive arrays for large file libraries. Two PCIe x16 and one PCIe x1 slot allow you to install high-end graphics cards and other expansion cards. Connect to a wireless network with Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, or make a wired connection with the integrated 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port. Resource-demanding peripherals such as storage drives can be connected to the USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 2x2 ports to quickly transfer data with enhanced speeds. USB 2.0 ports are also available for lower-powered devices such as mice and keyboards. Wireless peripherals such as headphones and controllers can be connected thanks to integrated Bluetooth 5.3 technology. This motherboard is compatible with both Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-Bit).

Enhanced Power Design

MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 motherboard is designed for gamers and enthusiasts, with a 12+1+1 dual rail power system and 8+8 pin power connectors to support the Core Boost technology, which boosts the performance of your multi-core Intel processor. Overclock your CPU with ease thanks to MSI Game Boost technology, which allows for 1-second rapid overclocking. The Digital Power Design, Overvoltage Protection, Load-Line Calibration, Double Power Connectors, and Supplemental PCIe Power Connectors on the motherboard all work together to provide proper electrical management through your system to stabilize your system, especially under high loads.

Premium Thermal Solution

The MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 Motherboard features Extended Heatsink Design and M.2 Shield Frozr and is designed for high-performance systems and continuous operation. This motherboard's increased cooling capabilities will keep your components working at optimal temperatures. M.2 Shield Frozr, Fully Fan Control, Frozr AI Cooling, and System Cooling all work together to keep your components cool even while under high loads when gaming or generating content.

High-Quality PCB for Enhanced Protection

The MSI MAG B760 TOMAHAWK WIFI DDR4 13th Gen Motherboard features a PCB optimized for higher bandwidth and faster transfer speeds, as well as reliable circuit transmission with 2oz thickened copper that allows the motherboard to easily withstand overclocking while improving heat dissipation and system reliability. The MSI PCI Express Steel Armor slot is soldered to the motherboard to handle the weight of large graphics cards and avoid GPU droop, which can damage PCIe slots. The grounding layer around the mounting holes is doubled for double ESD protection, preventing static discharge spikes from damaging the motherboard.

7.1-Channel USB High-Performance Audio

The 14th Gen Motherboard includes the Realtek ALC897 Codec as well as 7.1-Channel USB High-Performance Audio. Immerse yourself in your favorite media with Audio Boost technology, which includes high-quality audio capacitors, 3.5mm audio connectors with S/SPDIF, and a dedicated high-definition audio processor. The printed circuit board isolates audio layers for clear left and right channels, as well as isolating audio circuits to reduce crossover talk and electrical interference. To protect your ears, de-pop protection eliminates the popping sound caused by plugging or unplugging audio devices.

Lightning Fast Connectivity

Connect to your network wirelessly using Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, which provides faster wireless rates and efficiency, making it ideal for uploading and downloading large files. This motherboard also has a 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet connection for wired networking. MSI's LAN Manager software prioritizes your connection, eliminating lag and maintaining a pleasant online experience.

products.description:
MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI AM5 mATX Motherboard

The MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI is a powerful MSI motherboard based on the advanced AMD B850 chipset, designed specifically for customers who want to take advantage of the power of AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors with the AM5 socket. The MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI Motherboard supports up to 256GB of DDR5 memory over four dual-latch DIMM slots and offers excellent memory speeds of up to 8200+ MT/s (OC) depending on CPU and setup. It supports AMD EXPO, dual-channel architecture, JEDEC and AMD POR speeds, non-ECC UDIMMs, and CUDIMM clock driver bypass mode, providing maximum compatibility and overclocking freedom. Designed for enthusiasts, the MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI features a robust 12+2+1 Duet Rail Power System, dual 8-pin CPU power connectors, Core Boost, and Memory Boost technologies—reinforced by an 8-layer 2oz thickened copper PCB to enhance power delivery, signal integrity, and thermal performance. Expansion and high-speed storage capabilities on the MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI mATX Motherboard include one PCIe 5.0 x16 slot, one PCIe 4.0 x4 slot, and three M.2 slots—two of which support PCIe 5.0 x4 (when using Ryzen 9000/7000 CPUs) and one PCIe 4.0 x2 via the chipset, in addition to four SATA 6Gbps ports. RAID functionality supports RAID 0/1/10 for SATA and RAID 0/1/5 for M.2 NVMe drives, with RAID 5 available exclusively for Ryzen 9000 processors. Thermally, the MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI AM5 mATX Motherboard incorporates MSI’s Frozr Guard thermal design, which includes extended heatsinks, high-performance thermal pads (7W/mK), choke cooling, and EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II for optimal M.2 SSD performance and installation ease. Connectivity is next-gen with onboard Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, and Realtek 8126-VB 5G LAN, delivering blazing-fast network speeds for gaming, streaming, and professional workloads. The MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI Motherboard also features extensive USB connectivity: four USB 2.0 front ports, two USB 5Gbps Type-A front, four USB 5Gbps Type-A rear, three USB 10Gbps Type-A rear, a 10Gbps Type-C port on both front and rear panels, and a blazing-fast 20Gbps USB Type-C port on the rear I/O. For integrated graphics users, an HDMI 2.1 FRL port supports up to 8K resolution at 60Hz, depending on the installed APU. Audio is powered by the Realtek ALC4080 Codec, supporting 7.1-channel HD audio, 32-bit/384kHz playback, and S/PDIF output, enhanced by Audio Boost 5 for a studio-grade sound experience. The board has a number of internal connections and headers for fans, RGB lighting (3x JARGB_V2, 1x JRGB), front panel I/O, TPM 2.0, and more. MSI's EZ DIY features, including EZ PCIe Release, EZ M.2 Clip II, and EZ Antenna, make constructing and upgrading easier than ever. Troubleshooting is made easier with EZ Debug LEDs and an EZ Memory Detection LED. The MSI MAG B850M MORTAR WIFI mATX Motherboard, with its 243.84mm x 243.84mm mATX form size, combines high-end performance, overclocking headroom, cutting-edge connectivity, and user-friendly features, making it one of the most powerful and future-ready MSI motherboards in the AM5 family.

products.description:
MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard

The MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard is a powerful, ready for the future platform designed specifically for gamers and power users that want unparalleled stability, thermal performance, and cutting-edge connectivity. This MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI Motherboard is based on the sophisticated AMD X870E chipset and is compatible with the newest AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors, as well as the sturdy AM5 socket. It supports up to 256GB of DDR5 UDIMM across four DIMM slots, giving speeds ranging from DDR5 4800 MT/s JEDEC to an overclocked DDR5 8400+ MT/s, and has AMD EXPO profiles, dual-channel mode, and CUDIMM compatibility. Optimized memory routing on an 8-layer PCB made with 2oz thickened copper ensures signal integrity and consistent performance, while double-latch DIMM slots boost installation reliability. This MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI motherboard features triple PCIe x16 slots, with the primary slot offering full PCIe 5.0 x16 bandwidth, perfect for next-gen GPUs, while other slots support PCIe 4.0 and 3.0, enabling wide expansion options. For storage, the MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI ATX Motherboard includes four ultra-fast M.2 slots—two PCIe 5.0 x4 CPU sourced and two PCIe 4.0 x4 chipset sourced—supporting RAID 0/1/5/10 configurations depending on CPU, plus four SATA 6Gb/s ports for traditional drives. High-speed networking is delivered via a Realtek 8126 5G LAN and Wi-Fi 7 module, which includes Bluetooth 5.4, MLO, and up to 5.8Gbps wireless throughput. Rear I/O connectivity is extensive, including USB 40Gbps Type-C, USB 20Gbps Type-C, and multiple USB 10Gbps and 5Gbps ports, alongside USB4 with DisplayPort 1.4 and HDMI 2.1, supporting up to 8K at 60Hz resolution with compatible processors. Audio is powered by Realtek ALC4080, offering 7.1-channel high-resolution output with Audio Boost 5, ensuring a rich and immersive sound experience. With a 14+2+1 Duet Rail Power System, dual 8-pin CPU connectors, and additional PCIe power input, the MSI Motherboard ensures stable power delivery even under heavy loads. Advanced thermal features like Frozr Guard, thermal pads, extended heatsinks, and EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II guarantee optimal cooling. Designed with user convenience in mind, it includes EZ Debug LEDs, EZ M.2 Clip II, and EZ PCIe Release for simplified DIY building. With TPM 2.0 support, ARGB headers, and full compatibility with modern gaming and productivity setups, the MSI MAG X870E TOMAHAWK WIFI AM5 ATX Motherboard stands out as a top-tier choice for next-gen PC builds.

MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard

The MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X LGA 1851 ATX Motherboard is a high-performance motherboard that supports Intel Core Ultra CPUs (Series 2) and features an Intel Z890 chipset. As one of the most powerful MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X ATX Motherboards, it supports DDR5 memory with a maximum capacity of 128GB and boasts memory speeds ranging from 9600 MT/s (OC) to 6400 MT/s (JEDEC). The MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X Motherboard features dual-channel, non-ECC, unbuffered memory and supports Intel XMP 3.0 and memory overclocking. This MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X motherboard has several PCIe slots, including three PCIe x16 slots (Gen 5.0 and Gen 4.0), one PCIe x1, and six M.2 slots that enable PCIe 5.0 x4 for lightning-fast storage choices. Furthermore, the MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X motherboard has six SATA 6G ports, providing enough storage space. It has two Type-C DisplayPort with Thunderbolt 4 connectors, which allow 8K monitors and high-resolution output at up to 120Hz. The connectivity choices are extensive, with two Thunderbolt 4 connections capable of transferring data at up to 40Gbps and various USB interfaces, including 10Gbps Type-A and Type-C. The MSI Motherboard also has an Intel Killer E5000B 5G LAN and a pre-installed Intel Killer BE1750x Wi-Fi 7 module, which can offer rates of up to 5.8 Gbps. The Realtek ALC4080 Codec supports 7.1-channel USB High-Performance Audio at 32-bit/384 kHz. With RAID support for both SATA and M.2 NVMe devices, this motherboard is ideal for high-end gaming, multimedia production, and professional applications. The MSI MEG Z890 UNIFY-X Motherboard is compatible with Windows 11 64-bit, making it an excellent choice for power users.

products.description:
MSI MPG B650 EDGE WIFI DDR5 AMD AM5 ATX Motherboard

The MSI MPG B650 EDGE WIFI Motherboard supports AMD's Ryzen 8000 & 7000-series processors with up to 16 Zen 4 cores as well as dual-channel DDR5 memory, with a maximum memory capacity of up to 128GB and a bus speed of up to 6600+ (OC) MHz. It features Core Boost technology that combines MSI's premium layout and optimized power design, which allows for faster and undistorted current delivery to the CPU at pin-point precision. It not only supports multi-core CPUs, but also creates the perfect conditions for CPU overclocking. It has an extended Heatsink, MOSFET thermal pads rated for 7W/mK, additional choke thermal pads and a Double-sided M.2 Shield Frozr built for a high-performance system and a non-stop gaming experience. The motherboard is made of a 6-layer PCB made of 2 ounces of thickened copper and server-grade material. It can deliver a lightning-fast game experience with PCIe 4.0 slots, Lightning Gen 4 x4 M.2 with M.2 Shield Frozr design keeps M.2 SSDs safe while preventing throttling, making them run faster. The rear I/O panel now offers easy ways of directly entering the safe boot, a one-click toggle for all RGB lights, and directly activating Turbo mode. The MSI MPG B650 EDGE WIFI offers you ample connectivity options, giving you seven USB-A 3.2 Gen 1 and 2 ports with data transfer speeds up to 5 and 10 Gb/s, respectively, suitable for a wide range of peripherals such as capture cards, microphones, and more. A single USB-C 3.2 Gen 2x2 port offers up to 20 Gb/s speeds, suitable for audio arrays. The MAG B650 series motherboards offer a wide variety of options to connect and boost your USB devices, offering never before seen USB speeds up to 20 GB/s when connecting the rear USB Type-C. The MSI MPG B650 EDGE WIFI comes with a 3-year warranty.

The MSI MPG B850 EDGE TI WIFI Motherboard also has onboard HDMI, which supports up to 8K resolution (depending on the CPU), as well as PCIe expansion slots, making it ideal for high-performance applications. products.description:
MSI PRO A620M-B AM5 mATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO A620M-B AM5 mATX Motherboard is a high-performance, compact solution intended for contemporary AMD systems, making it an excellent choice for customers looking to build using cutting-edge technology. Powered by the AMD A620 chipset, the MSI PRO A620M-B Motherboard supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series Desktop Processors via the sophisticated AM5 socket, providing long-term compatibility and cutting-edge performance. The MSI PRO A620M-B has two DDR5 memory slots and can handle up to 128GB of non-ECC, unbuffered dual-channel DDR5 RAM at overclocked speeds of up to 6800+ MHz (1DPC 1R) and 6000+ MHz (1DPC 2R), as well as complete support for AMD EXPO memory profiles. Onboard graphics capability includes an HDMI 2.1 connector with 4K at 60Hz output and a legacy VGA port, which are both accessible on CPUs with integrated graphics, increasing adaptability for various display configurations. The MSI PRO A620M-B AM5 mATX Motherboard has a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot that converts to x16, x8, or x4 depending on the CPU used, as well as an extra PCIe 3.0 x1 slot. Storage is likewise versatile, with one PCIe 4.0 x4 M.2 slot (supporting 2280 and 2260 NVMe SSDs) and four SATA 6Gbps ports that support RAID 0, 1, and 10, making the MSI PRO A620M-B Motherboard suitable for both speed and redundancy in storage setups. Networking is driven by the Realtek RTL8125BG 2.5G LAN, providing ultra-fast wired connections, while the integrated Realtek ALC897 audio codec delivers 7.1-channel high-definition sound for immersive multimedia experiences. Connectivity on the rear I/O includes USB 3.2 Gen 1 5Gbps Type-A ports, USB 2.0, HDMI, VGA, audio jacks, LAN, and PS/2 keyboard and mouse support, while internal headers provide power connections, fan headers, USB ports, audio, TPM 2.0 support, addressable RGB (JARGB_V2) and RGB (JRGB) headers for lighting, and EZ Debug LEDs for simplified troubleshooting. The MSI PRO A620M-B measures 215mm by 243.84mm and fits inside micro-ATX cases, making it ideal for small yet powerful desktop configurations. The MSI Motherboard is compatible with Windows 11 and Windows 10 64-bit, providing a future-ready platform for gamers, artists, and professionals. Whether you call it the MSI PRO A620M-B, MSI PRO A620M-B Motherboard, or simply the MSI Motherboard, this board is a solid basis for any high-performance AMD system.

It has an extended Heatsink, MOSFET thermal pads rated for 7W/mK, additional choke thermal pads and a Double-sided M.2 Shield Frozr built for a high-performance system and a non-stop gaming experience. Two PCIe x16 and one PCIe x1 slot allow you to install high-end graphics cards and other expansion cards. Resource-demanding peripherals such as storage drives can be connected to the USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 2x2 ports to quickly transfer data with enhanced speeds. USB 2.0 ports are also available for lower-powered devices such as mice and keyboards. Wireless peripherals such as headphones and controllers can be connected thanks to integrated Bluetooth 5.3 technology. This motherboard is compatible with both Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit).

Premium Thermal Solution

The MSI PRO B760-P WIFI DDR4 Motherboard features an Extended Heatsink Design and M.2 Shield Frozr and is designed for high-performance systems and continuous operation. This motherboard's increased cooling capabilities will keep your components working at optimal temperatures. M.2 Shield Frozr, Fully Fan Control, Frozr AI Cooling, and System Cooling all work together to keep your components cool even while under high loads when gaming or generating content.

High-quality PCB for Enhanced Protection

The 14th Gen Motherboard features a PCB optimized for higher bandwidth and faster transfer speeds, as well as reliable circuit transmission with 2oz thickened copper that allows the motherboard to easily withstand overclocking while improving heat dissipation and system reliability. The MSI PCI Express Steel Armor slot is soldered to the motherboard to handle the weight of large graphics cards and avoid GPU droop, which can damage PCIe slots. MSI PRO B760M-P DDR4 Motherboard supports 14th/13th/ 12th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors for LGA 1700 sockets. It comes with four dual-channel RAM slots, and two M.2 slots allowing you to take advantage of the full power of 13th & 12th generation Intel processors. The four SATA III ports allow users to create large storage drive arrays for large file libraries. Two PCIe x16 and one PCIe x1 slot allow you to install high-end graphics cards and other expansion cards. Connect to a wireless network with Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, or make a wired connection with the integrated 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port. Resource-demanding peripherals such as storage drives can be connected to the USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 2x2 ports to quickly transfer data with enhanced speeds. USB 2.0 ports are also available for lower-powered devices such as mice and keyboards. Wireless peripherals such as headphones and controllers can be connected thanks to integrated Bluetooth 5.3 technology. This motherboard is compatible with both Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit).

Enhanced Power Design

MSI PRO B760M-P DDR4 motherboard is designed for gamers and enthusiasts, with a 12+1 Duet Rail Power System with P-PAK, 8-pin + 4-pin CPU power connectors, Core Boost, Memory Boost technology, which boosts the performance of your multi-core Intel processor. Overclock your CPU with ease thanks to MSI Game Boost technology, which allows for 1-second rapid overclocking. The Digital Power Design, Overvoltage Protection, Load-Line Calibration, Double Power Connectors, and Supplemental PCIe Power Connectors on the motherboard all work together to provide proper electrical management through your system to stabilize your system, especially under high loads.

Premium Thermal Solution

The MSI PRO B760M-P DDR4 Motherboard features Extended Heatsink Design and M.2 Shield Frozr and is designed for high-performance systems and continuous operation. This motherboard's increased cooling capabilities will keep your components working at optimal temperatures. M.2 Shield Frozr, Fully Fan Control, Frozr AI Cooling, and System Cooling all work together to keep your components cool even while under high loads when gaming or generating content.

High-Quality PCB for Enhanced Protection

The 14th Gen Motherboard features a PCB optimized for higher bandwidth and faster transfer speeds, as well as reliable circuit transmission with 2oz thickened copper that allows the motherboard to easily withstand overclocking while improving heat dissipation and system reliability. The MSI PCI Express Steel Armor slot is soldered to the motherboard to handle the weight of large graphics cards and avoid GPU droop, which can damage PCIe slots. The grounding layer around the mounting holes is doubled for double ESD protection, preventing static discharge spikes from damaging the motherboard.

Lightning Fast Connectivity

Connect to your network wirelessly using Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, which provides faster wireless rates and efficiency, making it ideal for uploading and downloading large files. This motherboard also has a 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet connection for wired networking. MSI's LAN Manager software prioritizes your connection, eliminating lag and maintaining a pleasant online experience.

MSI PRO B760M-P DDR5 mATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO B760M-P Motherboard supports 14th/13th/ 12th Gen Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors for LGA 1700 socket. It comes with four dual-channel RAM slots, and two M.2 slots allowing you to take advantage of the full power of 14th 13th & 12th generation Intel processors. The four SATA III ports allow users to create large storage drive arrays for large file libraries. Two PCIe x16 and one PCIe x1 slot allow you to install high-end graphics cards and other expansion cards. Connect to a wireless network with Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, or make a wired connection with the integrated 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet port. Resource-demanding peripherals such as storage drives can be connected to the USB 3.2 Gen 2 and Gen 2x2 ports to quickly transfer data with enhanced speeds. USB 2.0 ports are also available for lower-powered devices such as mice and keyboards. Wireless peripherals such as headphones and controllers can be connected thanks to integrated Bluetooth 5.3 technology. This motherboard is compatible with both Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-Bit).

Enhanced Power Design

The MSI PRO B760M-P motherboard is designed for gamers and enthusiasts, with a 12+1 Duet Rail Power System with P-PAK, 8-pin + 4-pin CPU power connectors, Core Boost, Memory Boost technology, which boosts the performance of your multi-core Intel processor. Overclock your CPU with ease thanks to MSI Game Boost technology, which allows for 1-second rapid overclocking. The Digital Power Design, Overvoltage Protection, Load-Line Calibration, Double Power Connectors, and Supplemental PCIe Power Connectors on the motherboard all work together to provide proper electrical management through your system to stabilize your system, especially under high loads.

Premium Thermal Solution

The MSI PRO B760M-P Motherboard features Extended Heatsink Design and M.2 Shield Frozr and is designed for high-performance systems and continuous operation. This motherboard's increased cooling capabilities will keep your components working at optimal temperatures. M.2 Shield Frozr, Fully Fan Control, Frozr AI Cooling, and System Cooling all work together to keep your components cool even while under high loads when gaming or generating content.

High-Quality PCB for Enhanced Protection

MSI PRO B760M-P 13th Gen Motherboard features a PCB optimized for higher bandwidth and faster transfer speeds, as well as reliable circuit transmission with 2oz thickened copper that allows the motherboard to easily withstand overclocking while improving heat dissipation and system reliability. The MSI PCI Express Steel Armor slot is soldered to the motherboard to handle the weight of large graphics cards and avoid GPU droop, which can damage PCIe slots. The grounding layer around the mounting holes is doubled for double ESD protection, preventing static discharge spikes from damaging the motherboard.

The MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI is a next-generation micro-ATX motherboard engineered for users who demand uncompromising performance, future-ready connectivity, and efficient thermal management in a compact form factor. Designed to support AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors on the AM5 socket, it unlocks the full potential of DDR5 memory with speeds reaching up to 8200+ MT/s (OC), ensuring ultra-fast responsiveness for gaming, productivity, and creative workloads. MSI’s Frozr Guard thermal architecture includes extended heatsinks, high-performance MOSFET pads rated at 7W/mK, and additional choke pads to maintain optimal temperatures during heavy loads. The EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II and tool-less installation clips simplify DIY builds, while the chipset heatsink minimizes dust and noise for long-term reliability.Connectivity is a standout feature, with integrated Wi-Fi 7 and Realtek 8126VB 5G LAN delivering ultra-fast, low-latency networking for streaming, gaming, and professional use. The MSI PRO B850M-P WIFI supports PCIe 5.0 graphics and Gen 5 x4 M.2 SSDs, enabling lightning-fast data transfer and next-gen GPU compatibility. Storage flexibility includes three M.2 slots and four SATA 6G ports, with support for RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10 configurations depending on CPU series. Audio Boost technology powered by Realtek ALC897 ensures immersive, studio-grade sound for gaming and media consumption.The rear I/O panel is packed with high-speed USB 10Gbps Type-A and Type-C ports, HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4 for 4K 60Hz output, and dedicated buttons for Flash BIOS and Clear CMOS. Internal headers support RGB and ARGB lighting, multiple fan configurations, TPM 2.0, and front panel USB connectivity, making it ideal for custom builds and future upgrades. MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard supports LGA 1700 CPUs from the 12th/13th generation Intel Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron families. This ATX motherboard, which uses the Intel Z790 chipset and the LGA 1700 socket, has four DDR4 RAM slots that allow twin-channel memory and speeds up to 5333 MHz when overclocked. GPUs and other adaptor cards may be installed through PCIe 5.0 x16, PCIe 4.0 x16, PCIe 3.0 x16, and PCIe 3.0 x1 slots. The Realtek ALC4080 audio codec offers 7.1 channel surround sound, and the rear ports can be used for analog or digital output. Connect connected peripherals through two USB 2.0, two USB 3.2 Gen 1, and three USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-A ports, or a USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C port. DisplayPort and HDMI are used to output video. A Flash BIOS button is also located on the rear I/O panel, and internal headers support front-panel USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C and USB 3.2 Gen 1 and 2.0 Type-A ports, RGB connections, chassis intrusion, a TPM module, and other features. The MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI DDR4 13th Gen ATX Motherboard comes with a 03-year warranty.

MSI PRO Z790-P WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard

The MSI PRO Z790-P WIFI DDR4 LGA 1700 ATX Motherboard offers sufficient connection and performance. This 14th Gen motherboard, which uses the Intel Z790 chipset and the LGA 1700 socket, has four DDR4 RAM slots that allow dual-channel memory and can be overclocked to 5333 MHz. Six SATA III and four M.2 connections offer storage space and enable RAID 0, 1, 5, and 10. Install GPUs or other adaptor cards through PCIe 5.0 x16, PCIe 4.0 x16, PCIe 3.0 x16, and PCIe 3.0 x1 slots. The Realtek ALC897 audio codec offers 7.1 channel surround sound, including rear analog output connectors. Connect connected peripherals through a USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C connector, two USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports, and four USB 2.0 Type-A connections. There is also a PS/2 port for connecting to older devices. DisplayPort and HDMI are used to output video. A Flash BIOS button is also located on the rear I/O panel, and internal headers support front-panel USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C and USB 3.2 Gen 1 and 2.0 Type-A ports, RGB connections, chassis intrusion, a TPM module, and other features. The MSI PRO Z790-P WIFI DDR4 ATX Motherboard comes with a 03-year warranty.

products.description:
Cooler Master ELITE 400 V4 230V ATX Power Supply

POWER UP

The Elite - v4 series power supply unit is a dependable choice for entry level PC builders and office work systems. The quiet 120mm fan, 80 PLUS White EU 230V efficiency, and 3 year warranty deliver a PSU that provides function and resilience you can count on. It's the perfect option for work horse systems stored and operated in less than ideal conditions and climates. This PSU has been engineered for reliability with a focus on reducing random shutdowns in conditions where power sources are inconsistent and unstable, making it ideal for locations prone to experience brown outs. The Elite - v4 is a complete solution, offering performance and stability at an affordable price.

ACTIVE PFC + FORWARD TOPOLOGY DESIGN

A power supply unit works by taking power directly from the wall or other fixed power source, converting it to the correct output required by the connected components, and then distributing that power to said components. If any part of this process is interrupted or executed poorly, the connected system components and the PSU itself could be damaged. Active PFC uses a circuit to correct power factor leading to reduced total harmonics, corrected AC input voltage, and increased overall efficiency output.

HIGH TEMPERATURE RESISTANCE

The new Elite - v4 has a maximum operating temperature of 40Â°C. That's at the level of many 80 Plus certified power supply units on the market today. This higher operating temperature allows you to power your system safely in warmer environments without having to worry about your system overheating or shutting off unexpectedly. The higher heat resistance also reduces temperature based wear, increasing the lifespan of the unit by a noticeable amount.

PEAK POWER TOLERANCE

This power supply unit can push out an additional 50W above maximum load for up to 10 seconds before turning off. This will allow your system a chance to save data and complete current processes in the event of output surge or overloading. While it may not be a feature you'll actively need all the time, it can be extremely useful in an emergency scenario.

80 PLUS WHITE EU 230V EFFICIENCY

The efficiency of your power supply unit is important because it directly affects your system's performance and your power bill. The efficiency rating does not reflect the quality or reliability of a PSU. It only reflects the unit's ability to move power from the wall to your components. The higher a PSU's efficiency is, the lower the total amount of power it needs to power your system. The Elite - v4 has a guaranteed typical efficiency of 85%.

DURABLE, RELIABLE, AND SAFE

The Elite - v4 will perform consistently in whatever environment you throw at it whether it's high altitudes above 5000 meters or ultra humid settings like a tropical rain-forest. This unit was designed for work systems meant to be used in extreme conditions with challenging temperatures. Do whatever you need to do wherever you need to do it without letting your hardware limit your goals.

Just plug it into your system and get to work. For a great mid-tier computing experience, you can't go wrong with the MWE Bronze V2.

80 PLUS BRONZE CERTIFIED

It's important to understand what efficiency is and what the ratings actually mean. The efficiency rating indicates how much power is retained and/or lost when transferring it from the wall to your components. It does not indicate the overall quality of the PSU. A PSU doesn't need an 80 PLUS Gold rating to be safe and reliable. And a PSU with an 80 PLUS Gold rating isn't necessarily either of those things. The MWE Bronze V2 guarantees a typical efficiency of 85% while being both safe and reliable.

120MM HDB FAN

The constant struggle between cooling and noise is as old as the consumer PC industry itself. Keeping your components cool without having to hear about it while you work is still one of the greatest challenges for all fan based cooling technologies. The MWE Bronze's solution to this problem is a thermally sensitive 120mm HDB fan. It spins based on the system's temperature, constantly adjusting to keep your PSU running smoothly and safely with the minimum amount of noise required.

SINGLE +12V RAIL

Getting power from the wall to the PSU and then to your components is a tricky situation. The power comes in one voltage level, but your components need a different one. That power has to first be transferred to/through a converter in order to make it safe for your parts to use without overloading. The lines/rails used to initially move power from the wall to the converter need to be reliable and consistent to ensure your system's overall performance. That's why the MWE Bronze only uses one +12V rail for this process. This way all the components in your system are constantly fed the same power from the same source in order to guarantee consistency between all connections.

DC-TO-DC CIRCUIT DESIGN

Power comes in multiple voltage levels. The wall delivers power in one voltage level but your components each need a specific voltage to operate properly. The process of converting raw power from the wall to the multiple voltage levels your components need requires special components to complete this process quickly, efficiently, and safely. The MWE Bronze's DC-to-DC + LLC technology was painstakingly crafted to accomplish this goal. The Dual Forward circuit layout has been designed to convert 12V power to 3V and 5V levels with minimal ripple noise, 80 PLUS Bronze efficiency, and reduced risk to your connected components.

FLAT BLACK CABLES

For many PC Builders with aesthetics in mind, cabling can be one of the most troublesome parts of assembling a PC. Cables can be confusing, too short or too long, and they almost never look good. The MWE Bronze - V2 uses flat and flexible black cables to help deal with these problems. These cables are more discrete and flexible, making them easier to implement into your system while taking up less space. This is especially useful for smaller cases and preserving airflow.

For the manufacturing processes, AMD also relies on TSCM for the Vermeer processors for the 7nm production of the CPU cores, although the I/O die is still supplied in 12nm by GlobalFoundries.

In games, AMD's Ryzen 7 5800X can convince with its significantly improved IPC and even put Intel in its place. With the AMD Ryzen 7 5800X, gamers are well prepared for the future as simultaneous streaming is no problem with the new Ryzen 7 5800X.
